title: Radio Frequency Engineer – Quantum & Measurement (Fixed-Term)
description:
At Bluefors, we are passionate about enabling the future of scientific discovery and quantum technology. As the world leader in ultra-low temperature measurement systems, we provide researchers and quantum computing companies with the tools they need to push the boundaries of innovation.

We are looking for a Radio Frequency Engineer to join our Quantum & Measurement team on a fixed-term basis. In this role, you will contribute to the development of advanced RF and microwave solutions for quantum computing applications and cryogenic measurement systems. Working alongside experienced engineers and scientists, you will have the opportunity to apply your technical expertise to real-world challenges and see your work rapidly transition into solutions used by leading organizations around the world.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their engineering career, as well as for a recent graduate or Master's degree student nearing completion of their studies, who is looking to gain hands-on experience in one of the world's fastest-growing technology fields.

As a Radio Frequency Engineer, you will support the design, development, and testing of microwave and high-density interconnect solutions for quantum computing and cryogenic measurement applications. You will work on RF prototypes, participate in laboratory testing and performance analysis, and contribute to the continuous development of technologies that enable next-generation quantum systems.

Your responsibilities will include designing and simulating RF solutions, developing test methodologies, analyzing measurement data, documenting technical work, and collaborating closely with multidisciplinary teams across Bluefors. Depending on your interests and experience, you may also contribute to scientific publications and intellectual property development.

What we expect from you

* Master's degree (completed or in progress), or PhD, in Electrical Engineering, Radio Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related field

* Some practical experience with RF assemblies (coaxial cables, flexible printed circuits, amplifiers, non-reciprocal devices, GHz-range analog systems), gained through work, internships, or thesis projects

* Familiarity with microwave test and measurement, and with data analysis in Python or a similar language

* Working knowledge of circuit simulation and layout tools (e.g. Keysight ADS, CST, AWR, Sonnet, Altium)

* Strong analytical skills and a willingness to take ownership of technical problems - Good communication skills and fluency in English

We also appreciate

* Experience with cryogenic measurement techniques

* Prior experience in quantum technology, aerospace, wireless/IoT, scientific instrumentation, or similar high-tech sectors

* Experience publishing scientific articles or contributing to patents

* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative research environment

* Knowledge of modern product development and project management practices

* Familiarity with computational methods and multi-physics simulations

Please apply as soon as possible, on September 13, 2026, at the latest through our recruitment system at BLUEFORS.COM. We will review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

For more information, please contact our Director, Quantum & Measurement, Russell Lake, russell.lake@bluefors.com.

title: Ordinarie servitör/barservitör med intresse för öl och bryggeri
description:
Park Alandia Hotell är ett hotell med 90 rum. I hotellet finns Park Restaurang & Bar med 70 sittplatser i restaurangen och 60 platser i baren. Här finns även en konferens- och festvåning och snyggaste poolen i stan! Skön live musik spelas fredag-lördag året om och vår uteservering med ca 90 sittplatser har många soltimmar. Hotellet kan från sensommaren 2026 även stoltsera med sitt egna bryggeri.

Park Alandia Hotell är ett familjeägt bolag där laganda, att ha kul på jobbet och att brinna för det man gör står i fokus. Hos oss jobbar 25 personer året runt och nu behöver vi förstärkning av en pigg och glad kollega till vår restaurang och bar.

Vi söker dig som brinner för öl och utöver servering i bar, restaurang och konferens även kan bistå vår bryggtekniker vid ölprovningar. Tids nog ser vi gärna att du även kan hålla egna provningar. Hos oss arbetar vi alla tillsammans som ett team mot gemensamma mål och vår ambition är att varje gäst ska trivas och få en härlig upplevelse hos oss. Det är med stolthet vi serverar god mat, drinkar och inom kort även öl från vårt egna bryggeri.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**

Vi söker dig som är noggrann och tycker om att ge gästen det lilla extra. Arbetsuppgifterna består av följande:

- Servera

- Duka av och på

- Kassahantering

- Blanda drinkar

- Bistå vid och även hålla ölprovningar

- Övrigt förekommande serveringsuppgifter


**Personliga egenskaper**

Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du vara serviceinriktad och alltid sträva efter att ge våra gäster den bästa helhetsupplevelsen. Som person är du positiv, ansvarstagande, stresstålig, har lätt för att samarbeta, och har förståelse för att alla arbetskamrater är värdefulla. Du har god struktur i ditt arbete samt ordning och reda runt om dig.

**Kvalifikationskrav**

Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med servering. Du behöver kunna svenska och engelska. Finska är mycket meriterande. Du behöver vara minst 20 år gammal samt ha alkopass/serveringspass.

**Varaktighet**

Tjänsten är på hel- eller deltid hos oss på Park Restaurang & Bar. Serveringsjobbet är skiftesarbete med ett rullande arbetsschema med kvällspass under veckans alla dagar. Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse, så snart som möjligt.

**Lön**

Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Vi ser framemot att läsa din ansökan och hoppas du skickar in den tillsammans med din CV redan idag till jobb@parkalandia.com ! Sista ansökningsdag är den 13.9.2026 men intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och platsen kan bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdag. Har du frågor kontakta Lizette på tel. 018-14130.

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Loviisan alueelle
description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Loviisan alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

title: Doctoral Researcher / Research Assistant in Law in the Academy Project JustISA
description:
Faculty of Law University of Lapland is hiring a doctoral researcher in law in the JustISA Academy project. The position is full-time during the period 1.1.2027 - 31.8.2029, located in Rovaniemi.

The project is carried out at the Faculty of Law in collaboration with the Department of Social Sciences within the Faculty of Human and Social Sciences at Åbo Akademi. Both research environments have a strong tradition of research on vulnerabilities and human rights, which is central to this project.

The project JustISA Surrogacy Agreements and Interdisciplinary Pathways to Minimum Justice: A Comparative Study of Finland, Colombia and Greece is an interdisciplinary collaboration between law and sociology. The project investigates international surrogacy arrangements and justice-related issues such as the childs best interests, the desire for parenthood, legislative circumvention, as well as risks and consequences for the individuals involved and for the legal systems through analysis of surrogacy agreements from Colombia and Greece, interviews, social media and other texts from online sources. The doctoral researchers thesis will primarily be based on surrogacy contracts and related expert interviews. The project group and the supervision team include experts in reproduction and parenthood, rights issues, law and the data mining method.

Work tasks

We offer you a social and independent job on an international and interdisciplinary project in a dynamic and pleasant work environment. The tasks of the doctoral researcher include:

- Contribute to project planning and project administration, for example in relation to project meetings

- Plan and implement data collection in relation to expert interviews and analyze surrogacy contracts in accordance with the project plan

- Write the scientific articles of the dissertation in collaboration with supervisors and researchers in the project

- Conduct a research visit abroad

- Completing doctoral studies and writing the thesis comprehensive summary

- Present research results at project meetings and national and international conferences

- Participate in other duties related to the role assigned by the employer. Tasks in teaching may occur to a small extent.

Competence

We are looking for you who have a masters degree, or who is finalising masters degree, in law, preferably masters studies in family law, contract law or law and welfare. Previous studies related to reproduction and/or experience with socio-legal research methods are considered meritorious. Previous experience of academic publishing is also considered a merit. It may also be possible to appoint a candidate who is currently completing their master's degree and who could start working as a research assistant if they are not yet eligible to apply for doctoral studies at the Faculty of Law during the autumn application period (15-29 September 2026).

We assume that you have very good knowledge of English. Knowledge of Finnish, Swedish, Greek or Spanish is an advantage. You also have good communication and collaboration skills as well as the ability to work independently and in a structured way.

We offer

- interesting work tasks as part of an international university community

- modern work equipment and facilities

- a stable organisation to work in

- opportunities for professional development

- extensive occupational health services

- sport, culture and wellbeing benefits.

Application

Submit your application via the Universitys electronic application form below. Attach the cover letter and CV with a list of publications as well as brief research plan (2-3 pages) regarding your JustISA related research interests and PhD project. The documents can be either in Finnish or English. Provide the contact details of reference persons that the employer can contact if necessary.

Information

For further information on the position, please contact Katja Karjalainen, Principal Investigator, phone number +358 40 187 1964, e-mail katja.karjalainen@ulapland.fi

In order to be employed as a doctoral researcher, the person who is employed must be enrolled as a doctoral researcher at University of Lapland no later than in connection with the start of the employment. Information about the application process for admission for a doctoral study right can be found here: [Apply for doctoral programmes - University of Lapland](https://ulapland.fi/en/study-with-us/apply-for-doctoral-programmes/)

It may also be possible to appoint a candidate who is currently completing their master's degree and who could start working as a research assistant if they are not yet eligible to apply for doctoral studies at the Faculty of Law during the autumn application period (15-29 September 2026).


Workplace address: Yliopistonkatu 8, 96300 ROVANIEMI
Duration of employment: 1.1.2027 - 31.8.2029
Work hours: full-time employment
Trial period: 6 months
Salary: The universitys salary system is based on the requirements of the task and personal performance. The position of research assistant adheres to requirement level 1 of the university salary system for teaching and research staff. The position of doctoral researcher adheres to requirement levels 2-3 of the university salary system for teaching and research staff. The starting salary of a research assistant is 2120,11 €. The starting salary of a doctoral researcher is 2331,67 - 2561,23 €. In addition, a personal performance-based salary component is paid, amounting up to 50% of the task-specific salary component.


Lapin yliopisto

Lapin yliopisto on kansainvälinen tiede- ja taideyliopisto aivan napapiirin tuntumassa Rovaniemellä, Lapin pääkaupungissa. Arktinen yliopistomme luo uutta tietoa, taitoa ja osaamista pohjoisen puolesta, maailmaa varten. title: Ravintolatilojen siivooja, Ruka
description:
Osa-aikainen siivooja ravintolatilojen siivoukseen

Etsimme asiakkaallemme luotettavia siivoajia ravintolatilojen siivoukseen. Työnkuvasi on siivota ravintolatiloja ja työvuorot tulevat painottumaan pe-ma välillä aamu-/päiväajalle klo. 06:00-13:00, mutta on myös arkivuoroja. Osan työstä pystymme myös suorittamaan klo. 13:00 jälkeenkin, joten työajat ovat joustavat oman käytettävyytesi mukaan. Työpäivien kesto vaihtelee riippuen siivottavasta kohteesta 4-6h. 

Kanssamme sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella työajoistasi, työpäivien määristä viikoittain sekä työajankohdista riippuen mahdollisista muista töistä, joita teet. Työ sopiikin joustavan luonteensa takia erinomaisesti esimerkiksi henkilöille, jotka haluavat osa-aikaisia töitä tai sitten lisätunteja oman työnsä oheen. 

Jotta olisit sopiva työhön, niin täytyy sinun olla valmis siivoamaan välillä hurjaksikin lipeävien juhlien railakkaita jälkiä. Siivoustekniikat, perusperehdytyksen työhön ja uudet ammattimaiset työvälineet tulet saamaan asiakkaaltamme, joten työhön voit hakea vaikka sinulla ei vielä kokemusta siivousalalta olisikaan. Toivomme kuitenkin, että et ole helposti säikähtävää luonnetta, sillä siivoustyön tiimellyksessä voit törmätä tahraan jos toiseenkin 

Tarjolla ei ole erikseen työn puolesta majoitusta, joten ennenkuin haet työtä, niin on sinulla oltava jo majoitus tai asunto lähialueella sekä tietenkin kulkuväline, jos liikut kauempaa kuin Rukan kylältä töihin. 

Palkkaa työtehtävästä maksetaan sopimuksen mukaisesti 12,59-14€/h + lisät kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta noudattaen.

Töitä on tarjolla nopeimmille jo syksystä alkaen ja jatkuen ympäri vuoden sesonkeja kuitenkin mukaillen! 

In english;

Looking for someone living in Ruka or nearby to pick up extra hours in restaurant cleaning!

We are looking for reliable cleaners for our client who are interested in earning extra income through part-time cleaning work. Your job will be to clean restaurant spaces, with shifts primarily scheduled between Friday and Monday in the morning or daytime hours from 6:00AM to 1:00PM. Some tasks can also be completed after 1:00PM, making work hours flexible to fit your availability. The duration of each shift varies depending on the cleaning site, ranging from 4 to 6 hours.

With us, you have the opportunity to negotiate your working hours, the number of workdays per week, and the exact scheduling of shifts based on any other jobs or commitments you may have. Thanks to its flexible nature, this job is perfect for those looking for part-time work or extra hours alongside their primary job. 

To be suitable for this role, you should be prepared to clean up after some wild parties at times! You will receive training on cleaning techniques, a basic introduction to the job, and new professional cleaning equipment from our client, so you can apply even if you have no prior experience in the cleaning industry. However, we do hope youre not easily startled—because in this job, youll encounter all kinds of messes!

Accommodation is not provided as part of the job, so before applying, please make sure you already have a place to stay in the area and a means of transportation if youre commuting from outside Ruka village.

The salary for this role is between €12,26 and €14 per hour, plus additional compensation in accordance with the collective agreement for the real estate services industry.

Work is available for the quickest applicants starting from the Autumn, and can continue year-round, adjusting to seasonal demand!

Lisätietoja, some more details you can ask from: 

Julianna Grönberg
julianna.gronberg@wulff.fi

Parempi maailma työntekijä kerrallaan!


Wulff Works on se parempi henkilöstövuokrausyritys. Meillä konkarit etsivät sankareita: tunnistamme hyvät työpaikat ja työnantajat, jotka arvostavat tekijöitä. Palvelemme valtakunnallisesti ja tapaat meitä jo kahdeksalla paikkakunnalla Suomessa.

title: Research Assistant / Forskningsassistent (Academy of Finland-project REALS)
description:
About the job

This is a tight call for a Ukrainian-speaking RESEARCH ASSISTANT to be employed for project REALS – Relational Ethics and Affective/Lived Security: Care, Resilience and Embodiment in Times of Crisis and Hanken School of Economics.

Hanken School of Economics is a leading, internationally accredited business school, recognized for its international orientation and outstanding research quality in proportion to its size. We have close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 16 000 alumni. We are located in Helsinki and Vaasa, Finland.

Project

Project REALS explores how security is organised when formal systems are under strain, such as in times of war, disaster, or large-scale societal disruption. Bringing together perspectives from organisation studies, ethics of care, and arts-based research, the project extends understandings of security as purely institutional or technical. A central focus is how care, trust, and shared responsibility emerge in everyday practices when communities respond to crisis situations. The research draws on fieldwork conducted in Ukraine, including observations and interviews with emergency responders, humanitarian actors, and members of civil society.

Work

The tasks can be, but are not limited to:

- transcribing and translating interviews
- data search online (YouTube interviews, public media articles, reports, and other publicly available sources)
- participant recruitment and fieldwork activities, including identifying potential interviewees, assisting with interview scheduling and coordination, and, where appropriate, conducting interviews.
- assisting in the planning and organization of research dissemination and stakeholder engagement activities, such as seminars, workshops, and other communication events.

Employment: part-time employment (80 %), 1.10.2026-31.12.2026 (with a possibility of extension).

Job requirements

- good proficiency of English and Ukrainian, both spoken and written.
- good personal skills and ability to work as a member of a team.

- Please note that the research project engages with sensitive topics and contexts. Candidates should therefore be prepared to work with potentially challenging material and demonstrate an awareness of: emotional self-management and well-being, self-care practices when engaging with sensitive research data, ethical and secure data management. Training, guidance, and relevant support resources will be provided throughout the project.
- Familiarity with, and genuine interest in, the research context and subject matter will be considered a strong asset.

Documentation to be attached:

- CV
- Cover letter
- Language certificates if the skill level is not apparent in other attached documents
- Additional attachments, e.g. degree certificates, work experience and other merits that the applicant wishes to be considered

The salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (including employee healthcare, pension, and holiday contributions) and placed on job requirement level 4-6 for administrative staff, with an additional personal performance-based salary element.

For more details of the position, please contact the project PI, Anna Dziuba, anna.dziuba@hanken.fi.

Applications including the CV and other relevant documentation should be submitted in Hanken recruitment database LAURA no later than 06.09.2026.

___________________________________________________________

Forskningsassistent (ukrainsktalande) till projektet Finlands Akademi-projektet REALS vid Hanken Svenska handelshögskolan

Om positionen

Vi söker en ukrainsktalande forskningsassistent som ska anställas inom projektet REALS – Relational Ethics and Affective/Lived Security: Care, Resilience and Embodiment in Times of Crisis vid Hanken Svenska handelshögskolan.

Hanken är en ledande, internationellt ackrediterad handelshögskola som är erkänd för sin internationella profil och höga forskningskvalitet i förhållande till sin storlek. Vi har nära samarbete med näringslivet och ett aktivt alumnnätverk med över 16 000 alumner. Hanken finns i Helsingfors och Vasa.

Projektet

Projektet REALS undersöker hur trygghet och säkerhet organiseras när formella system utsätts för påfrestningar, exempelvis under krig, katastrofer eller omfattande samhälleliga störningar. Genom att förena perspektiv från organisationsforskning, omsorgsetik och konstbaserad forskning utvecklar projektet förståelsen av säkerhet bortom rent institutionella eller tekniska perspektiv.

Ett centralt fokus är hur omsorg, tillit och delat ansvar växer fram i vardagliga praktiker när samhällen och lokalsamhällen hanterar krissituationer. Forskningen bygger på fältarbete i Ukraina, inklusive observationer och intervjuer med räddningspersonal, humanitära aktörer och representanter för civilsamhället.

Arbetsuppgifter

Arbetsuppgifterna kan inkludera, men är inte begränsade till:

- transkribering och översättning av intervjuer
- informationssökning på internet (YouTube-intervjuer, offentliga medieartiklar, rapporter och andra offentligt tillgängliga källor)
- rekrytering av deltagare och fältarbetsaktiviteter, inklusive identifiering av potentiella intervjupersoner, stöd vid tidsbokning och koordinering av intervjuer samt, när det är lämpligt, genomförande av intervjuer
- medverkan i planering och organisering av forskningsspridning och aktiviteter för intressentdialog, såsom seminarier, workshoppar och andra kommunikations-arrangemang

Anställning: Deltidsanställning (80 %) 1.10.2026–31.12.2026 (med möjlighet till förlängning)

Kvalifikationskrav

- goda kunskaper i engelska och ukrainska, både muntligt och skriftligt
- god samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att arbeta som en del av ett team
- Observera att forskningsprojektet behandlar känsliga ämnen och sammanhang. Kandidater bör därför vara beredda att arbeta med potentiellt krävande material och visa medvetenhet om: emotionell självhantering och välbefinnande, egenomsorg vid arbete med känsligt forskningsmaterial, etisk och säker hantering av forskningsdata. Utbildning, handledning och relevanta stödtjänster erbjuds under hela projektets gång.
- Erfarenhet av och ett genuint intresse för forskningskontexten och ämnesområdet ses som en betydande merit.

Bilagor som ska bifogas ansökan

- CV

title: Power System Analyst
description:
We are looking for aPower System Analyst to join our Business Development team.OurBusiness Development team supports market development and decarbonisation service activities globally by identifying, analysing, and developing new value propositions for our solutions by combining world-leading energy system modelling capability with market and business knowhow.
If you possess ambition, a forward-thinking development mindset, proactive problem-solving abilities, a keen willingness to learn, and a strong interest in professional growth, we may have the perfect opportunity for you. Whether you are a recent graduate or on the verge of completing your studies, we invite you to be a part of our multicultural and international work environment as we drive forward the energy transition.

About the position
This role provides a unique opportunity to support us in shaping the energy transition and the energy business atWärtsilä.The position will be based in Helsinki, Finland.

As a Power System Analyst, you will:
* Actively engage in and provide robust support for our global market development and decarbonization service activities, utilizing power system modelling tools such as Plexos – power system optimization software, Python and Excel-based tools. Leverage these tools to analyse opportunities and quantify system-level benefits.
* Conduct comprehensive energy market and country analyses to underpin project and market development initiatives, offering valuable insights and strategic guidance.
* Collaborate in supporting Wärtsilä strategy by contributing to the development of compelling value propositions, conducting feasibility analyses, and creating sophisticated analysis tools.
* Perform techno-commercial analyses for projects, playing a key role in supporting the sales organization and ensuring a thorough understanding of the market landscape.
* Effectively communicate and present analysis results to both internal and external stakeholders of Wärtsilä. This includes active participation in meetings, seminars, and other influential events where insights can drive informed decision-making.
* Take ownership of developing and maintaining power system models and feasibility calculation tools, ensuring their accuracy and relevance in the ever-evolving energy landscape.
* Contribute to the advancement of process-based system modelling, with a focus on data storage and handling, as well as result analytics and visualization. Stay at the forefront of developments in this field to continually enhance our modelling capabilities.


To be successful in this role, certain qualifications should align with your profile:
* Recently graduated from university or nearing graduation, with a major in economics, finance, operations research, computer science, or other quantitatively focused disciplines and a general understanding of modern electric power systems.
* Alignment with our core values – Customer Success, Passion, and Performance – should resonate with you, and you naturally embody these values in your daily work, demonstrating ownership and responsibility.
* Possess excellent analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, showcasing an ability to model and resolve complex issues.
* While knowledge of Python, Plexos or power system modelling software is advantageous, prior experience is not mandatory.
* Possess a basic understanding of data analytics and coding.
* Being a team player with strong interpersonal skills is crucial, along with a genuine interest in the energy business and enthusiasm for travel.
* Fluency in English. Other language skills are considered a plus.


Why you and us?
You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.
Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.
You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact & next steps
Please submit your application before the application deadline of 11 September 2026 through our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered. After submitting your application, you will receive a confirmation email.

In case of any questions regarding the position, reach out to:

Michael Ball
Director, Business Development, Wärtsilä Energy
michael.ball@wartsila.com

title: Waiter / Waitress / Tarjoilija
description:
WAITER / WAITRESS / TARJOILIJANPOSITION AVAILABLE AT NORTHERN LIGHTS VILLAGE LEVI





The Northern Lights Village brand was born in 2016 and since then we have opened three resorts in Finnish Lapland. We pride ourselves in delivering consistently warm and personalized service to our guests. Everyone working at the Northern Lights Village embraces this mission with great care and responsibility. We appreciate the insight of every individual and see our employees as our most valuable resource.
Our guests are truly international and so is our team, speaking all together 17 languages!


We are currently looking for enthusiastic and professional Waiters / Waitresses to join our restaurant team. This vital role ensures that our dining experiences continue to meet and exceed guest expectations, providing service that is both attentive and seamless.

The Waiter / Waitress position entails delivering exceptional dining service to our guests. You will work closely with our kitchen to ensure that every meal is a memorable part of the Northern Lights Village experience.

You should be able to work quickly, answer customer queries and take and deliver orders. You should possess a polite and charismatic character.
This position requires someone who can manage a high-paced environment with grace, effectively communicate with an international clientele, and contribute positively to our team's dynamic.

Our restaurants serve mainly buffet breakfast, lunch and dinner, with occasional à la carte-reservations taking place.

* Provide warm and engaging service to every guest

* Understand and communicate menu items effectively, including any allergen information

* Coordinate with the kitchen to ensure timely service

* Maintain cleanliness and presentation of the dining area

* Handle payments and perform closing duties

* Finnish Alcohol Legislation Proficiency Certificate

* 2 or more years of experience in restaurant service

* Excellent communication skills and a friendly demeanor

* Fluent in spoken and written English

* Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment

* Flexibility to work shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays

WHAT WE OFFER

* Competitive salary

* Opportunities for professional development and training

* A positive and supportive working environment

* Discounts across our properties and facilities

Pay, Duration and Benefits


*

*

* Starts: September/October, Ends: March/April

* Minimum 90 working hours per 3 weeks period


* Hourly pay negotiated in an interview, according to knowledge and experience

* Other benefits according to the collective labor agreement

* If necessary, the resort provides accommodation in a shared room for €300,00/month

HOW TO APPLY

Mitä tarjoamme

Palkka ja työnkesto

title: Asiakaspalvelu-, myynti- ja markkinointitehtävä
description:
Monipuolinen asiakaspalvelu-, myynti- ja markkinointitehtävä

Millainen henkilö sopii meille?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea oma-aloitteista, palveluhenkistä ja yhteistyökykyistä tekijää, joka ei säikähdä vaihtelevia työpäiviä. Hotellin vastaanotto ja ravintolamme ovat yhtenäinen kokonaisuus, joten toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä koko henkilöstömme kanssa.

Sinulla on positiivinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen asenne, nautit asiakkaiden kohtaamisesta ja osaat pitää langat käsissäsi myös kiireessä. Arvostamme kykyä tarttua toimeen itsenäisesti, mutta yhtä tärkeää on halu tehdä hyvää yhteistyötä muun tiimin kanssa.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

- hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- myynnillistä otetta ja kiinnostusta liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen

- organisointikykyä ja oma-aloitteisuutta

- joustavuutta ja valmiutta vaihteleviin työtehtäviin

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja englannin kielen osaamista

- valmiutta työskennellä myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.


Aikaisempi kokemus hotellin vastaanotosta, ravintolasta, myynnistä, markkinoinnista tai esihenkilötehtävistä on eduksi, mutta asenne ja halu oppia ovat meille vähintään yhtä tärkeitä kuin täydellinen lista aikaisemmasta kokemuksesta.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työn, jossa pääset näkemään matkailu- ja ravintola-alan toimintaa laajasti. Mahdollisuus toimia vastaanottopäällikön vanhempainvapaan sijaisena ja kasvattaa omaa vastuutasi. Monipuolinen työnkuva, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen. Mahdollisuus hyödyntää ja kehittää osaamistasi myynnin, markkinoinnin ja asiakaspalvelun parissa. Tiivis työyhteisö, jossa jokaisen panoksella on merkitystä.

Jos olet henkilö, joka viihtyy sekä asiakkaiden parissa että käytännön tekemisessä, ja haluat työn, jossa saat ottaa vastuuta ja käyttää monipuolisesti omaa osaamistasi, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille, miksi juuri sinä olisit hyvä lisä joukkoomme.

title: Senior Financial Controller
description:
Senior Financial Controller

Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.

Finance Competence Center (FCC) is a centralized financial unit providing accounting services for 26 legal units in 13 countries in Europe and North America.

As a Senior Financial Controller, you will play a key role in financial reporting and controlling of Nokian Tyres Group. You will be part of Groups global finance team preparing and supporting in subsidiaries globally.

You will work closely together with business control team and other stakeholders. We expect you to have experience of working in a challenging, international business environment and you have ability and motivation to drive continuous improvement. You have open-minded approach and self-driven working style.

Key responsibilities:

- Participate in monthly/quarterly/yearly reporting (including asset accounting, inventory accounting, taxation etc.) and closing
- Provide financial analysis and reconciliation
- Ensure accuracy of financial records, financial closing, and reporting
- Manage fixed assets processes, including capitalization, depreciation, and disposals.
- Ensure the correctness of figures by controlling and analyzing the account information and results
- Oversee and lead the annual closing, statutory financial reporting and audit
- Support and instruct other team members in accounting and taxation related issues
- Develop and harmonize global financial processes, policies, and quality of operations
- Participate to development and automation activities in accounting and finance
- Participate in forecasting and optimizing tax position

What we expect from you:

- Applicable education, e.g., Masters degree in accounting
- Work experience in similar field of responsibility area
- Knowledge in accounting, taxation and reporting processes is required, IFRS is an advantage
- Advanced Excel skills and experience from creating and developing new reporting tools
- Good team-working and communication skills both in English and Finnish, other languages are considered an advantage
- Analytical developer mindset to improve and harmonize processes
- Ability to work under pressure and responsibility
- Compliance with policies, processes and procedures is obvious to you

Our way of working

Our talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters, and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.

Please note that prerequisite of the employment is that the selected employee has a valid residence and work permit in Finland.

Are you interested in joining our inspiring team?

Please fill in the application form with CV and salary request by 4th September 2026. We will be starting the interviews as soon as we receive potential applications, so dont wait too long!

For further information please contact: Katja Vikki, tel +358 50 301 5551 e-mail katja.vikki@nokiantyres.com. You can best reach her on Aug 24th, 9-10.00, Aug 26th 8.30-9.30 or Aug 28th 8-10.00.

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja, Jyväskylä, Keljo (40142)
description:
Haemme Keski-Suomen hyvinvointialueen henkilökohtaisen avun keskuksen kautta avustajaa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen 33-vuotiaalle naiselle Jyväskylään Keljoon. Lisäksi etsitään avustajaa sijaisrinkiin 0-tuntisopimuksella. Työnantajalla on osittainen selkäydinvamma ja hän liikkuu itsenäisesti manuaalipyörätuolilla, mutta kynnyksissä, pidemmillä matkoilla sekä vaihtelevassa maastossa tarvitsee työntöapua. Ulkoillessa käyttää sähköpyörätuolia. Siirtymiset onnistuvat itsenäisesti pystyasennon kautta, myös rollaattorin avulla pystyy pieniä matkoja kävelemään.

Työtä tarjotaan 34 h/viikko päivittäisiin toimiin ja 30 h/kk vapaa-aikaan, tunnit jaetaan kahden avustajan kesken. Työvuorot suunnitellaan kuukaudeksi eteenpäin, huomioiden työnantajan menot. Työtä on pääasiassa aamu- ja iltapäivä painotteisesti, mutta voi olla myös iltaisin sekä vähintään kahtena viikonloppuna kuukaudesta.

Työnantaja tarvitsee apua päivittäisissä toimissa kuten pukeutumisessa, hiusten kiinnilaitossa ja ruuanlaitossa. Kodin hoito kuten siivous, tiskienlaitto, sängyn petaus ja roskien vienti kuuluvat avustajan työtehtäviin. Työnantaja tykkää elokuvissa, festareilla ja keikoilla käymisestä, mutta erityisen tärkeänä hän kokee ulkoilun ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan luonnossa liikkumisen. Työnantaja tykkää askarrella, tehdä makramee töitä ja leipoa. Eläimet varsinkin koirat ja kissat ovat lähellä sydäntä, vaikkei omaa lemmikkiä tällä hetkellä olekaan. Työnantaja on aktiivisesti mukana järjestöissä ja erilaisissa vertaistapaamisissa sekä käy puhumassa kokemustoimijana opiskelijoille ja muille vertaisille. Palkka Heta TES A 13,23 €/h +mahdolliset kokemuslisät.

Avustajaksi haetaan tunnollista, joustavaa, reipasta, puheliasta, avointa ja lämminhenkistä ihmistä. Aikaisempaa kokemusta avustajan työstä ei tarvitse olla, motivaatio työtä kohtaan ja huumorintaju katsotaan eduksi.

Työsuhteet ovat aina yksityisiä. Työsuhteeseen valittu henkilö on työsuhteessa avustettavaan.

Haastatteluun valitulle tieto ilmoitetaan henkilökohtaisesti.

Työ alkaa sopivan avustajan löydyttyä.

Työnantajalla on oikeus pyytää iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työhön valitulta työntekijältä rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi kerran työsuhteen alkaessa (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

Rikosrekisteriote on salassa pidettävää tietoa ja sitä ei tule lähettää hakemuksen yhteydessä.

title: Projektmedarbetare till vårt arbete med barn och familjer
description:
Vi rekryterar en medarbetare till vårt team för förebyggande familjearbete i Pargas för perioden 1.10.26-31.7.27. Arbetets huvudsakliga uppgift är att arbeta inom projektet **Hav och Hem – föräldrafärdigheter för en trygg vardag och bättre barndom i skärgården**.

Vi erbjuder dig

- Ett intressant och mångsidigt arbete med fokus på att stärka föräldraskap, familjers välmående och barns uppväxtvillkor.

- Arbete är självständigt, men det finns ett mångprofessionellt team som du är del av.

- Varierande arbetsuppgifter.


**Vad är Hav och Hem?**

Hav och Hem är ett tvåårigt utvecklingsprojekt (1.8.25-31.7.27) som stärker föräldraskap, familjers resiliens och tillgången till stöd i Pargas och på Kimitoön. Projektet riktar sig till svensk-, finsk- och flerspråkiga familjer med barn i åldern 0–18 år samt till professionella som möter föräldrar i sitt arbete. Målet är att stärka familjers resurser i vardagen och bidra till en trygg barndom i skärgården. Projektet finansieras av Leadergruppen I samma båt rf och Svenska kulturfonden.

**I arbetet ingår att**

- genomföra individuell föräldrahandledning,

- planera och leda gruppverksamhet för föräldrar,

- samarbeta med professionella och aktörer i regionen,

- planera och genomföra informationstillfällen, nätverksträffar och familjeevenemang,

- utveckla och producera material för föräldrastöd och kommunikation,

- dokumentera, följa upp och utvärdera verksamheten,

- delta i kommunikation och marknadsföring av projektet,

- delta i projektets avslutande skede och bidra till att resultat, erfarenheter och lärdomar tas tillvara.


**Vi förutsätter att du har**

- Lämplig högskoleutbildning inom social- och hälsovård.

- God samarbetsförmåga och goda kommunikationsfärdigheter.

- Förmåga att arbeta självständigt, strukturerat och initiativrikt.

- Ett professionellt och respektfullt bemötande i mötet med familjer och samarbetspartner.

- Berömliga muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i svenska och finska.


**Som merit räknas**

- Erfarenhet av arbete med barn, unga och familjer.

- Erfarenhet av föräldrastöd, handledning eller gruppverksamhet.

- Kunskap om eller erfarenhet av evidensbaserade föräldrastödsprogram.


Arbetsplatsen är Pargas, men arbetet är rörligt och utförs i Pargas och på Kimitoön, vilket förutsätter körkort och möjlighet att använda egen bil i arbetet.

Som arbetsförmåner erbjuder vi Smartum Pay (kultur-, motions- och massageförmån), två åkband per år till Borgbackens nöjespark, arbetsvälmående- och personaldagar samt företagshälsovård.

Intervjuerna påbörjas under ansökningstiden och befattningen fylls genast då vi hittar en lämplig kandidat.

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
We are looking for a **Restaurant Manager** to join **Wilderness Hotel Muotka**.

In this role, you'll lead the daily operations of the restaurant, build and support a high-performing team, and ensure our guests receive the level of service Wilderness Hotel Muotka is known for. You won't be managing from behind an office door—you'll be part of the daily operations, supporting your team and solving situations as they arise.

Your shifts are mainly scheduled in the evenings, when the restaurant is at its busiest.

**What would your workday look like?**

Before service – preparing for the evening

Your shift begins by reviewing the day's situation. You'll go through guest numbers, schedules, staffing, and any special requests, making sure everything is ready before dinner service begins.

During the busiest part of the winter season, breakfast, lunch, and dinner are all served as buffets at Muotka.

Before dinner service, you'll brief the team, assign stations and responsibilities, and make sure everyone knows their role for the evening. Throughout the day, you'll work closely with the kitchen, reception, and other hotel departments to ensure everything runs smoothly.

**Evening – where the action is**

As Restaurant Manager, you're part of the restaurant team.

You'll work alongside the waitstaff, meet guests, step in wherever needed, and make sure service flows smoothly throughout the evening. At the end of the shift, you'll typically complete the daily cash reconciliation and reporting.

**What the job includes**

- Leading the daily restaurant operations

- Supervising and supporting a multicultural restaurant team

- Ensuring excellent guest experiences and service quality

- Beverage ordering, stock management, and reporting

- Working closely with the kitchen and other hotel departments

- Taking an active role in the restaurant's daily operations


**What we expect from you**

- Previous experience in a restaurant management or supervisory role

- The ability to lead by supporting and motivating your team

- Strong organisational and prioritisation skills

- The ability to stay calm in a busy service environment

- Fluent Finnish and English

- Excellent communication and teamwork skills


**What you get from this experience**

Working in Lapland is more than just a job.

Wilderness Hotel Muotka is located next to **Urho Kekkonen National Park**, close to the Kiilopää fell area. After work, nature starts right outside your door—you can step straight onto the cross-country ski trails from the hotel yard. During the season you'll experience the polar night, northern lights, and the first sunrise after midwinter.

We also offer Wilderness Hotels employee benefits and staff accommodation if needed.

The apartments are clean and fully equipped—you'll only need to bring your toothbrush and warm winter clothing. During the winter season, accommodation is shared, with two employees per room.

If you enjoy working with us and would like to continue after the winter season, your employment may be converted into a permanent position. As part of a larger hotel group, we're able to offer year-round career opportunities across our different destinations. During Muotka's summer closure, your role and location may change.

**Salary and terms**

- Starting salary: **€3,000/month + supplements**

- Final salary depends on experience and qualifications

- Employment starts in **October 2026** (no later than mid-October)

- Fixed-term employment until **4 April 2027**, with the possibility of a permanent position


**Working hours bank**

All employees have access to a working hours bank. Working hours vary throughout the season, and extra hours worked during busier periods can later be taken as time off. Any unused hours will be paid out at the end of employment.

title: Housekeeping Shift Supervisor – Wilderness Hotel Saariselkä
description:
We are looking for a **Housekeeping Shift Supervisor** to join our team at Wilderness Hotel Saariselkä for the winter season 2026–2027.

Wilderness Hotel Saariselkä is one of the most high-end properties in our collection, and that is reflected in our housekeeping standards too. Here, the details matter. Our public areas and accommodation units need to be spotless, but just as important is how everything feels to the guest when they arrive: is everything ready, and is everything exactly where it should be?

As a Shift Supervisor, you will be the day-to-day lead of the housekeeping team. You will take part in the hands-on housekeeping work while making sure tasks are divided sensibly, everyone knows what they are responsible for, and the day runs smoothly. You won't be doing it alone – you will have the support of the Housekeeping Supervisor responsible for the Saariselkä area.

**What would your workday look like?**

**Morning – getting the day started**

The day starts by going through the current situation. You will check which accommodation units need to be cleaned, how the work should be divided, and whether there is anything special to take into account that day.

There is no escaping snow or freezing temperatures in this job, as all our accommodation units in Saariselkä are separate cabins. You will spend quite a bit of time moving around outdoors during the day, so a positive and energetic attitude is definitely an advantage.

**Daytime – attention to detail**

Naturally, most of your day will be spent doing housekeeping work. At Wilderness Hotel Saariselkä, our standards are high, and it is often the smallest details that make the biggest difference.

In addition to keeping the accommodation units and public areas clean, you will make sure everything is exactly as it should be. The job may also include delivering pre-ordered packages or birthday surprises to guests' rooms. And if you enjoy creating towel arrangements or finding other small ways to make a guest's stay a little more special, you will have the opportunity to do that here too.

Sometimes a good dose of common sense and initiative is needed. There won't always be a ready-made instruction for every situation – and that's okay. What matters is that you can see the bigger picture, make sensible decisions, and ask when you're unsure.

**Throughout the day – keeping the team on track**

As Shift Supervisor, you will help the team stay on top of things. You will divide the day's tasks, follow their progress, and adjust the plan when needed.

You will be right there doing the work alongside the team – this is not a role where you manage housekeeping from the sidelines. At the same time, you will be an approachable source of support for your colleagues and help create a positive atmosphere where working together feels good.

**What the job includes**

- Organising and assigning the housekeeping team's daily tasks

- Cleaning public areas and separate accommodation cabins

- Ensuring high housekeeping standards and quality

- Preparing and delivering special requests and surprises to guest rooms

- Guest service and cooperation with other hotel departments when needed

- Making sure cleaning supplies and equipment are available

- Supporting and guiding the team in their daily work

- Solving practical problems and prioritising tasks as situations change


**What we expect from you**

- Previous experience in housekeeping or hotel cleaning

- Previous experience or willingness to take responsibility for leading a team

- A careful approach to your work and a good eye for detail

- Initiative and common sense

- Good communication skills and a positive attitude

- Ability to work efficiently and independently

- Fluent English

- A valid B-category driving licence


Previous experience in high-end hotel housekeeping is considered an advantage. More importantly, we are looking for someone who takes pride in doing things properly and understands how much good housekeeping contributes to the guest experience.

**What you get from this experience**

**Working in Lapland is more than just a job.**

Wilderness Hotel Saariselkä is surrounded by the beautiful landscapes of Saariselkä. After your shift, you can swap your work clothes for outdoor gear and head straight into the fells – cross-country ski tracks, snowshoeing routes and other winter activities are all right nearby.

During the winter, you will experience the polar night, northern lights and the return of the sun at the end of January. And when you work somewhere where the scenery is part of everyday life, you don't have to go looking for it.

We also offer **Wilderness Hotels employee benefits** and the possibility of staff accommodation. The apartments are clean and fully equipped – in practice, you only need to bring your toothbrush and warm outdoor clothing.

During the winter season, accommodation is shared, with two employees per room.

**Salary and terms**

- Starting salary: €2,500/month + supplements, final salary depends on experience and qualifications

- Employment for the winter season 2026–2027

- Working hours according to the work schedule


**Apply now**

If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and take pride in seeing a job well done, you might be exactly the person we're looking for.

Apply through the electronic application form on this page.

We will begin processing applications immediately.

title: Independent B2B Sales Partner – 3D Visualization, Product Configurators and VR
description:
I am Soyhan Yazgan, a software developer based in Orimattila, Finland. I have six years of software-consulting experience, including 4.5 years working on an Unreal Engine–based digital instrument-cluster project for Ford Motor Company.

I hold a bachelors degree in Software Engineering from Metropolia University of Applied Sciences and a masters degree in Game Business Management from Kajaani University of Applied Sciences. My core tools include Unreal Engine, 3ds Max, Corona Renderer and V-Ray.

I am now establishing an independent 3D/VR development studio and looking for a B2B sales partner whose commercial and relationship-building skills complement my technical expertise.

**What we would initially sell**

- Pre-rendered and real-time 3D visualization for architecture, machinery, furniture and vehicles, including still images, animations, interactive walkthroughs, and imagery for websites and print catalogs

- Interactive configurators for vehicles, kitchens, furniture systems, industrial equipment and other modular products

- VR or desktop-based product demonstrations, technical training applications and simulations


Potential customers include industrial manufacturers, training providers, construction and real estate companies, and marketing or design agencies that need a reliable white-label technical partner.

Typical projects run from several weeks to several months, with budgets of approximately €5,000–€30,000 excluding VAT, depending on scope. Engagements may begin as paid pilot projects, develop into recurring production work, or be delivered as larger phased projects.

**Your role**

- Identify and approach suitable B2B prospects

- Reach the appropriate decision-makers and qualify opportunities

- Arrange and lead introductory sales conversations

- Join discovery, proposal and negotiation meetings

- Help position the solution around the customers business problem

- Attend relevant trade fairs or customer meetings when mutually agreed


I will handle technical discovery, demonstrations, estimates, project scoping and delivery. We will agree on pricing boundaries together, and no proposal will be submitted without mutual approval.

**Commercial arrangement**

This is initially a flexible, non-exclusive independent partnership; not salaried employment. There is currently no guaranteed retainer or minimum number of hours.

Proposed commission model:

- 20% of collected project revenue, excluding VAT and agreed third-party expenses, for clients you source and actively help close


Commission would be paid proportionally as customer payments are received. Lead ownership, existing contacts, repeat projects, cancellations and post-termination commissions would be defined in a written agreement before outreach begins.

The arrangement is particularly suitable for an independent sales professional or agency that already serves relevant B2B customers and wants to add 3D, Unreal Engine or VR services to its offering.

**You may be a good fit if you have**

- Experience selling custom B2B services or technology projects

- Professional Finnish and English communication skills

- Strong prospecting, relationship-building and negotiation skills

- Contacts in manufacturing, training, construction, real estate or marketing

- The ability to work independently and represent technical services professionally


A particular degree is not required. Relevant results, relationships and business judgement are more important.

**Interested?**

Please send me:

- A short introduction

- Your LinkedIn profile

- The sectors in which you have experience or contacts

- An example of a B2B service or project you have helped sell


Email: soyhan15@gmail.com

I would be happy to arrange an introductory meeting to discuss the offering, target customers and cooperation model.

Soyhan Yazgan

title: Receptionist / Customer Service Employee for a Family-Run Hotel in Enontekiö, Finnish Lapland
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic, helpful and outgoing receptionist / customer service employee to join our team for the **winter season, from late November until early April**.

If you love the winter atmosphere of Lapland and would enjoy sharing that enthusiasm with guests from around the world, you may be the person we are looking for!

This is a **fixed-term seasonal position from late November until early April**. Salary is determined in accordance with the MaRa collective agreement.

Main responsibilities

- Checking guests in and out.

- Providing customer service at reception, including selling drinks and small snacks.

- Providing local travel information and recommending routes and activities.

- Keeping the lounge area welcoming, tidy and comfortable.

- Assisting with breakfast, meal service or small beverage service when needed.


We would like you to have

- A valid Hygiene Passport and Alcohol Serving Passport.

- Fluent Finnish and English.

- Swedish, Norwegian or other language skills are considered an advantage.

- Experience using Hotellinx is considered an advantage.

- The ability to communicate confidently with both domestic and international guests.

- Excellent social skills: you are outgoing, positive and comfortable interacting with different people.

- A genuine interest in winter tourism in Lapland and a willingness to give guests recommendations on activities such as northern lights viewing, skiing, snowshoeing, winter trails and local culture.

- Good physical fitness.


Previous experience is not necessarily required. The most important qualities are the right attitude, initiative and a willingness to learn.

We will hire the right person as soon as we find them.

If you are coming from elsewhere in Finland or from abroad to enjoy the Lapland winter, we can help you find accommodation.

title: Chef for the Winter Season – Family Hotel in Enontekiö, Finnish Lapland

We hope you have:

- Good Finnish language skills; English is considered an advantage

- The ability to independently prepare breakfast, lunch, and dinner

Come and work in the spectacular surroundings of Käsivarsi, Finnish Lapland, for the winter season!

title: Procurement Analytics Manager | Mehiläinen | Bucharest or Helsinki
description:
Mehiläinen is Finland's largest private healthcare and social services group, operating across seven European countries. Group Procurement is in the middle of a deliberate shift, away from periodic reports that sit in an inbox until someone opens them and self-service dashboards, toward a live intelligence layer that flags what matters before anyone has to ask. We are looking for someone to help design that shift, not maintain what already exists.

The opportunity
This role reports to the Head of Procurement Excellence, with visibility that reaches the CPO and CFO from day one. You will work at group level across every category and country we operate in, which means real influence without the overhead of managing a team. If you have been looking for a role where impact is not measured by headcount, this one is built for that.

What you will build
Design and own the group's savings tracking methodology, working directly with FP&A so every number holds up under scrutiny
Architect a live view of spend, price, and supplier performance that replaces static reports and dashboards with insights and alerts separating signal from noise and people actually can act on
Decide what should trigger an escalation, not just document what already happened, by building the thresholds and exception logic that keep leadership informed without being asked
Shape how AI and automation change the way the function measures itself, from spend classification to compliance monitoring
Build the sustainability reporting Mehiläinen needs as ESG expectations grow, including CO2 data and supplier risk tracking
Take a real seat at the table in Mehiläinen's group procurement technology roadmap, from tool selection through implementation

Is this you?
This probably is not the right fit if you are looking for a brief and a template to fill in. It is the right fit if you would rather decide what gets measured and why, and you are comfortable being the person who makes that call and challenges the status quo.
You have spent enough years at the intersection of financial controlling, procurement, data, or analytics to have formed your own opinions about how it should be done, whether that came from a controller seat, a reporting role, or something less conventional
You have owned a data or reporting problem end to end at least once, from raw numbers to a decision someone else made because of your work
You are genuinely curious about where AI and automation are taking procurement and analytics, not as a buzzword but as something you want to build with
You can hold your own in a room with the CPO and CFO, translating complex data into something a non-technical leader can act on immediately
Professional proficiency in English

What we offer
You will join Group Procurement at the point where its data and reporting foundation is still being built, with a real mandate to shape it. Meaningful visibility with senior leadership from day one, a flexible and hybrid way of working, and a competitive package. Mehiläinen is Finland's largest private healthcare and social services provider, with a mission and a growth trajectory people want to be part of.

Pleasesubmityour application and CV through our recruitment site by 20thSeptember.
Wereviewapplicationson a rolling basis and invite selected candidatestointerview duringtheapplicationperiod. Please note that we do not acceptapplicationsbyemail.

For more information about the role, please contact:
Emil Stoica, HR Business Partner
emil.stoica@reginamaria.ro

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Askolan seudulle
description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Askolan seudulle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

title: Office Services and Physical Security Manager - Nordics
description:
**Join Our Team as the Office Services & Physical Security Manager – Nordics**

Are you a proactive, development-oriented professional with a passion for ensuring smooth operations and top-notch security? We are looking for a dedicated Office Services & Physical Security Manager to oversee and enhance our office environments across the Nordics and safeguard our sites with expert security management.

**About the Role:**

As the Office Services & Physical Security Manager, you will be the key person responsible for the daily operation and maintenance of all AXA Partners offices in the Nordics. You will also serve as the Physical Security Manager for all our sites, ensuring compliance with security policies, mitigating risks, and maintaining a safe and efficient working environment. This is a hands-on role where you'll be present at the Helsinki office five days of the week to ensure everything runs like clockwork!

**Your Responsibilities:**

- Manage facilities operations, including maintenance, visitor access, and office supplies.

- Coordinate with service providers, landlords, and internal teams to ensure high standards of office management.

- Oversee security systems, access controls, and conduct security audits to identify and address potential risks.

- Support health & safety policies, fire regulations, and emergency procedures.

- Lead efforts in security compliance, incident reporting, and risk mitigation.

- Provide administrative support across Nordic offices, including expense management, procurement, fleet management and documentation.

- Arrange and coordinate on-site training, meetings, or events, including bookings for restaurants, hotels and travel.

- Foster a safety-first culture and continuously seek improvements in operational and security practices.


**What Were Looking For:**

- Proven experience in facilities or office management within a corporate setting.

- Strong knowledge of security management practices and systems demonstrated through relevant education or practical experience.

- Excellent communication skills in Finnish, Swedish, and English.

- Ability to handle multiple tasks with attention to detail and a proactive approach.

- Strong coordination and negotiation skills to effectively manage suppliers, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

- A professional, customer-oriented approach with excellent interpersonal skills.

- Flexible, with a willingness to travel within the Nordics if needed.


**Why Join Us?**

At AXA Partners, we are passionate about helping others and making a difference. With a team of over 8,500 professionals worldwide, we thrive on innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence. Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your expertise will contribute to safe, efficient, and welcoming workplaces across the Nordics.

Starting salary for this position is 3500-4100euros monthly. In addition to the base salary, our compensation package currently includes valuable benefits such as:

- Epassi benefits for lunch, wellbeing, culture and commute

- Annual bonus scheme to support your performance

- Comprehensive occupational healthcare at Terveystalo

- Employee assistance program offering confidential support and resources for all aspects of your life

- Insurance benefits


**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are ready to take on this exciting challenge and help us create secure, well-managed offices across the Nordics, we want to hear from you!

To apply, click on the apply now button, you'll then need to log in or create a profile to**submit your CV and cover letter by September 1st**.

Were proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer and dont discriminate against employees or potential employees based on protected characteristics. If you have a long-term condition or disability and require adjustments during the application or interview process, please send an email to AXA Partners Global HR Response - globalhr@partners.axa

**Who we are:**

We're AXA Partners, experts at designing and delivering assistance solutions and specialised insurance, credit, and lifestyle protection – with and for our partners worldwide. What sets us apart? The expertise and passion of our 8,500+ people, and a strong network of over 55,000 professionals all over the world. Powered by them and our sector-leading technology, we continuously evolve, adapt and thrive – offering solutions and services that make sure were always at peoples side, no matter what. Helping others is our passion. Combining the best digital technology with our warm, human touch, were always looking at new ways to offer seamless and reassuring experiences when it really matters.

Join a company that helps protect the forests! At AXA Partners, we plant a tree for every new recruit with a permanent contract.

title: Chef, seasons 2026-2027, Northern Finland, Lapland Hotels
description:
Are you ready for a winter youll never forget? Imagine working above the Arctic Circle, surrounded by pure nature, snow-covered forests, and the calm of Lapland. Your days are spent creating high-quality food, and your free-time could mean chasing the Northern Lights, visit Santa Claus, skiing, or relaxing in a traditional sauna.

StaffPoint is currently seeking passionate CHEFS to well-known Lapland Hotels-chains hotels and ski centers around Lapland. The role involves supporting the Chef de Partie, Sous-Chef or Chef de Cuisine with daily food preparation to meet the set standards and quality levels of our client, the Lapland Hotels-chain in northern Finland.

Choose your season in Lapland:

- Join us for a short, intensive Christmas season

- Or commit to the full winter season 2026–2027 (approximately November–April)

You can work with us in the following locations in Lapland: Kilpisjärvi, Luosto, Rovaniemi, Pallas, Ylläs, Levi, Hetta, Saariselkä or Olos.

What we offer:

- The possibility of accommodation through Lapland Hotels

- Staffpoint and Lapland Hotels personnel benefits

- A lively and international work environment

- Many winter leisure opportunities in beautiful Lapland

- A memorable season that stands out on your CV

What we require:

- EU citizenship/passport or a valid working permit for Finland

- Minimum of two years' experience of working in a restaurant as chef

- Finnish Hygiene certificate (We can provide assistance with applying for a certificate)

- Strong understanding of food safety and kitchen procedures

- Ability to work efficiently in a fastpaced role


How to apply:

Add your CV to your application to speed up the recruitment process! Please note that if you are applying with a friend, both applicants must submit their own application. If you meet our standards, you will first receive an invitation to a video interview and a Refapp request for recommendations.

Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland!

Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. An essential part of the safari selection is dog sledding experiences, which are provided by Lapland Husky Safaris, a member of the same tourism group. The company is the largest operator in its field in Finland and has four kennels in Rovaniemi, Luosto, Saariselkä, and Muonio. Lapland Ski Resorts consists of five ski resorts located in Ylläs, Luosto, Olos, Pallas, and Rovaniemi

Email: pohjoinen@staffpoint.fi

More information and details: pohjoinen@staffpoint.fi

Please fill the online application, attach your CV, certifications and recommendation letters.

More info of the Lapland Hotels-company:https://www.laplandhotels.com/EN/

title: Chemist (Senior Expert)
description:
We are always on the lookout for a talent with a growth mindset – are you the one?

We are looking for a Chemist that will be titled Senior Expert / Expert, Fuels with a main responsibility in the Fuel Laboratory. The location for this position is Vaasa, Finland.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Senior Expert / Expert, Fuels you will provide expert chemical competence to support Wärtsilä's fuel related technology development, engine testing, customer projects and fuel specification work as well as support on troubleshooting challenges. The role ensures high quality laboratory analysis, development of new analytical methods and expert interpretation of results for conventional, bio based and emerging sustainable fuels. The position supports Wärtsilä's strategic targets related to decarbonisation, fuel flexibility and reliable engine operation.
Requirements for the position:

* M.Sc. in Chemistry or related field

* Strong laboratory experience of instrumental analysis in a chemistry laboratory
* Fluent English communication skills, Swedish and/or Finnish a strong benefit
* Ability to work independently and take ownership
* Willingness to perform hands-on laboratory work when required


Qualifications/to be able to succeed in the position we expect you to have:

* A Team player with good collaboration skills in cross-functional teams
* See working in a Chemistry Lab as a dream work were to work & develop long term
* Experience with advanced analytical instruments (e.g. IC, XRF, GC, ICP-OES, FTIR, TGA/DSC)
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
* Structured way of working and ability to interpret data, reporting and support technical decisions
* Interest in method development and continuous improvement
* Experience in fuel analysis or petrochemicals and knowledge of alternative fuels (e.g. ammonia, hydrogen, methanol) is seen as an advantage



Why you and us?

You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.

Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.

You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact and next steps

Please submit your application before the application deadline 30th of August 2026 through our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered. After submitting your application, you will receive a confirmation email.

In case of any questions regarding the position, reach out to:

Olai Lagus,
General Manager, Fuel Laboratory
+358 505675543 or olai.lagus@wartsila.com

title: Préparateur en industrie F/H
description:
Vous êtes à l'aise avec les plans techniques et les outils DAO ?
Vous aimez optimiser, programmer et trouver les meilleures solutions techniques ?
Rejoignez une entreprise spécialisée en chaudronnerie et découpe laser / jet d'eau en tant que Préparateur Méthodes / Programmation et devenez un acteur clé de la performance industrielle !

Pourquoi rejoindre notre client ?
Entreprise spécialisée avec un haut niveau d'expertise technique.
Poste stratégique au coeur de la production.
Environnement stimulant mêlant technique et optimisation.
Possibilités d'évolution selon votre implication.Vos principales activités :
Analyser les documents techniques du dossier client.
Élaborer les programmes de découpe en optimisant :
La consommation matière
Les temps de production
Vérifier la disponibilité des matières premières et leurs certificats.
Définir les exigences qualité et les tolérances à respecter.
Réaliser un auto-contrôle rigoureux des programmes :
Dimensions
Matière
Quantité
Conformité globale
Échanger avec les clients si nécessaire (faisabilité technique).
Apporter un support technique aux opérateurs.
Assurer la transmission des consignes entre équipes.
Maintenir un environnement de travail propre et organisé.

Votre rôle & vos responsabilités :
Vous êtes garant(e) de la fiabilité des programmes de découpe
Vous assurez la conformité des programmes aux exigences clients
Vous respectez la planification définie par votre hiérarchie
Vous identifiez les anomalies et alertez en cas de non-conformité

description:
Dans le cadre de son ouverture au mois de novembre, MONKY recrute un commissaire de piste (Karting) (H/F).

Le commissaire de piste contribue directement à la sécurité des pilotes et du public ainsi qu'à la qualité de l'expérience client sur le circuit de karting.

Il est garant du bon déroulement des sessions, du respect des règles de sécurité et de la réactivité en cas d'incident.

Vos missions principales :
-Sécurité & surveillance de piste :
- Assurer la sécurité des pilotes et du public pendant toute la durée des sessions.

- Utiliser la signalisation par drapeaux (jaune, rouge, damier, etc.) conformément aux procédures.

- Contrôle & vérification du matériel
