title: Engineering Manager - PureBallast
description:
Do you want to make a difference in the world? We do. It's the reason Alfa Laval and Wallenius water have developed Alfa Laval PureBallast - a system to treat ballast water and prevent invasive species from spreading between marine ecosystems. We have had a market leading position since the launch in 2006, and we sell systems to ship owners and shipyards worldwide. We are in a very fast-paced market driven by environmental legislation. Now we are looking for an Engineering Manager who wants to help us make a difference in the world.



Who are you?

You are a business-minded leader with a passion for technology and innovation. Analytical, process-oriented, and conscientious, you strive to exceed expectations and inspire those around you. You empower your team, foster collaboration, and actively contribute to their development. Your strong communication skills and relationship-building abilities enable you to work effectively across departments and with external stakeholders.





About the job

As Engineering Manager, you will lead and motivate a team of highly skilled design engineers, driving product development and product care for the PureBallast system.



Key responsibilities:

    

Lead, inspire, and develop the engineering team in product development and product care projects.

    

Ensure all new designs comply with applicable standards and regulations (IMO, USCG, Class, ISO, and internal requirements).

    

Provide technical support and verification for new designs.

    

Support supply chain and purchasing activities.

    

Drive and implement technical innovations.

    

Oversee resource planning, recruitment, and daily operations of the team.

    

Serve as a member of the R&D Management team.



This position is based in Flemingsberg, Stockholm and you can expect up to 15 days of travel annually.



What you know

    

University degree in Engineering or a related field provides a solid foundation for understanding technical aspects of the role.

    

5+ years of experience in leading teams of highly skilled specialists.

    

Experience of product development processes.

    

Experience from maritime industry is a merit.

    

Experience of explosion proof design is a merit.

    

Fluent in Swedish and English is a requirement.



What's in it for you?

We offer a challenging position in an open and friendly environment, where you will have the possibility to impact on the maritime environment. You will be part of a highly motivated R&D team where we help each other to develop and create value.

The PureBallast product is marketed and sold entirely by Alfa Laval, and you will act within the global Alfa Laval organization, with many international contacts, both internally and externally.



You will be employed by AlfaWall AB.



For more information, please contact
Jakob Essinger, Head of Research and Development,

Regina García Moguel, Talent Acquisition Partner,



Union information

Axel Scharing, Akademikerna,

Anders Jansson, Unionen,



We review applications continually so please send in yours as soon as possible and not later than September 13th, 2026.



Please note that, in compliance with GDPR, we cannot accept applications submitted via email.



We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.



As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.

title: Consumer Engagement & Activation Specialist
description:
Join us to deliver a smoke-free future as a Consumer Engagement & Activation Specialist!

We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

In the Nordic region, we are 1,800 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.

Role summary:

This role will deliver, support and execute on set annual event plans based on Sweden specific Legal Age Meeting Point (LAMP) & Event objectives. You will also secure strong brand and consumer engagement events and activation in own channels and events/festivals where the brands are present. The role is securing brand growth/equity and consumers’ brand perception (awareness, understanding, engagement, likeability).

This role will require work outside of standard office hours and include some weekends.



Please note that this is a fixed term position until end of May 2027 (with the possibility of extension).



What You’ll Do:

• Support and execute event activities based on annual event plan and contribute to the full omni-channel strategy and find ways to further optimize the plan.

• Supervise events and coordinate potential 3rd party.

• Collaborate with service providers/vendors and manage the quality of provided services.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with agencies and ensure the brand identity is successfully translated across all creative work. Provide clear briefs, budgets, outlining strategy, the scope of assignments and project timelines.

• Budget and service order management for local market and individual projects.

• Through collaboration with other teams generate insights, information in order to improve brand appeal, marketing effectiveness and brand volume & share performance.

• Ensure that all events and activities are in full compliance with local market regulations, the PMI Marketing code and business conduct policies and practices.

                                          

Skills & Capabilities

• A minimum of 3 years of experience with event management

• Strong networking and stakeholder management skills

• Proficiency in Swedish and English is required

• Possess a driver’s license (B)                              



Rewards & Benefits

Our success depends on the people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can:

• Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.

• Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.

• Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.

• Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.

• Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke free future.

title: Product Manager EMEA- Troax
description:
What happens when commercial insight, product strategy, and market understanding come together to shape the future of a business? As Product Manager EMEA, that challenge becomes part of everyday work.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of one of Troax's most strategically important product areas, influencing both current performance and future growth. By combining business acumen, analytical thinking, and stakeholder collaboration, the role helps ensure that Troax continues to deliver market-leading solutions to customers across Europe.

Your new team

Across Europe, teams at Troax work every day to create safer and more efficient environments for customers in manufacturing, warehousing, and intralogistics. Product Management plays a central role in that mission by translating customer needs, market trends, and business opportunities into competitive product offerings that create value for customers and drive profitable growth.

As part of the EMEA Product Management and R&D organization, close collaboration happens across Sales, Production, Marketing, Sourcing, Commercial Excellence, and global product functions. It’s a highly international environment where expertise, teamwork, and a shared ambition to improve continuously drive success.

About the job

As Product Manager EMEA, responsibility covers both the strategic and operational management of the portfolio across the EMEA region. The portfolio includes adjacent product categories. The role shapes the future offering by continuously evaluating the portfolio, identifying market opportunities, and driving product development initiatives that strengthen Troax’s customer value proposition. The product area represents a significant share of the company's business and plays a key role in Troax's continued development and profitability.

The position offers a balanced mix of strategic and operational responsibilities. Long-term portfolio planning, roadmap development, and future product initiatives are combined with pricing, commercial analysis, market intelligence, and daily support to the business. It is a broad commercial role with a strong influence on both product direction and business performance.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Managing and developing the EMEA product portfolio.

    

Driving the product roadmap and future product development initiatives.

    

Defining pricing strategies and supporting commercial growth through data-driven decision-making.

    

Conducting financial, market, competitor, and customer analyses to identify opportunities and support business decisions.

A high degree of ownership comes with the role. Day-to-day portfolio decisions, pricing activities, and business analyses are managed independently, while larger product and portfolio decisions are aligned through the wider product management organization. Success depends on the ability to influence stakeholders, build alignment, and drive progress in a matrix environment without formal people management responsibility.

Based in Jönköping or Hillerstorp, Värnamo, this role offers the opportunity to work at the center of Troax’s EMEA Product Management organization while collaborating with colleagues, customers, and stakeholders across Europe. The role includes regular international interaction throughout the EMEA region and travel for customer visits, trade fairs, training sessions, and sales conferences. The position reports to the Product Management & R&D Director EMEA.

Profile

A relevant academic background in Engineering or Business provides a solid foundation for the role. Experience from product management, category management, business development, product marketing, strategic pricing, or a similar commercially oriented position is highly relevant. Experience from manufacturing, warehousing, material handling, intralogistics, or other industrial B2B environments is advantageous. Strong analytical capability and business understanding are important, together with the ability to translate market insights into profitable business decisions. Fluency in English and the ability to communicate effectively across functions, cultures, and organizational levels are essential.

Commercial curiosity, ownership, and energy create success in this role. Building trust across functions comes naturally, and complex discussions are navigated with confidence, clarity, and respect. Strong stakeholder management skills help drive decisions and create momentum even without formal authority. A proactive mindset, combined with sound judgment and a genuine interest in customers and business development, enables long-term impact in a dynamic international environment.

Why Join Troax?

At Troax, you’ll join a global market leader with a strong growth agenda and a clear purpose: creating safer workplaces around the world. How to apply

If this opportunity sounds right for you, we look forward to hearing from you.

We are partnering with Gruffman Recruitment & Consulting in this recruitment process. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, no later than Sept 15. For questions about the role, contact Ulrika Gruffman at ulrika@gruffman.nu.

Troax is the global leader in mesh panel safety solutions - and we’re passionate about creating safer workplaces around the world. Founded in Sweden and now active in over 40 countries, we help customers protect people, machinery, and property through smart, reliable solutions for machine guarding, warehouse partitioning, and property protection.

Our growth continues strong: in 2025, sales totaled approximately €261 million, and we are now about 1,600 employees working together to drive innovation, quality, and customer value. Join a company with a friendly culture, a forward-thinking mindset, and the ambition to make a real difference.

Learn more: www.troax.com

title: Network-Focused Cloud Engineer
description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Job Description

Do you find satisfaction in understanding how your technical expertise enables our business applications and by that be able to Power Climate Smarter Living?

We need to strengthen our cloud operations team with an additional colleague who is driven by technical challenges and the urge to always find better and more efficient ways of delivering services to the customer.

The Digital Platform Operation Team is a multi-competence Team, operating the Vattenfall Digital Platform; this comes with a big variety of tasks to ensure stable cloud systems. Those tasks are governance (ensuring architectural and security compliance), IaaS, PaaS, Network operation, Monitoring support, Azure DevOps support and capacity management. To handle all those different topics we must automate as much as possible and provide self-service functionality.

Your responsibilities:

As our Cloud Engineer your major responsible for ensuring a stable cloud platform which is evolving with the needs of the organization.

Specific tasks would include:

    Cloud Networking
    Understanding Cloud-onPrem connectivity (ExpressRoute, MPLS, BGP)
    Design, deploy, and manage cloud-based network architectures (e.g., VPCs, subnets, routing, paas specific subnet creation, network Segmentation, private endpoints).
    Collaborate with DevOps, security, and development teams to integrate networking solutions.
    Automate network infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like PowerShell, Bicep / Arm.
    Monitor and troubleshoot network performance issues in cloud environments.
    Knowledge in designing and operating Next Gen Firewall Environments, ideally Check Point.
    Scripting
    Writing scripts in Powershell, Bash
    Automation and orchestration
    Creating and maintaining automation based on scripts using e.g. REST
    Configuration Management
    Using tools like ARM templates, Bicep but also Ansible or DSC
    OS support
    Troubleshooting OS issues with Windows and Linux
    Governance
    Ensuring proper usage of tagging, permission handling, naming and policies
    Support platform audits
    Financial analyses
    Having a good understanding of the cloud financial model and the TCO
    Giving advice on cloud consumption
    Security
    Manage and react on alerts from Azure Security Center
    Guiding projects together with IT security for secure implementation
    Source Code Management (Azure DevOps)
    Manage Azure DevOps (create project rooms, licenses management, feature enablement)
    Backlog handling

Location  

Stockholm, Amsterdam, Berlin or Katowice

Qualifications

Your profile

In the role as Cloud Engineer with the focus on Network you will be working in a team that is very close to business but also to Agile IT and Core IT. To succeed in this role it is important that you have the ability to get an T-shaped skill profile. Whereas it is expected you are an expert on Network in Cloud environments. However do also have a basic understanding of OS, Backup, Security, Databases, Web, Azure Paas Services to still be the a generalist we are looking for. So there is not one person dealing e.g. with Network it is the whole team. Since automation is key for our delivery, you are also expected to have the ability to code and/or script. You need to be able to let go of traditional way of working and be open for a fast changing and developing environment.

You are not only an expert technician but you also have social competence and understands the need of the business. You always challenge yourself and others how to improve and develop and are open for suggestions from others but can also give your own.

As Cloud Engineer you dispose of the following qualifications and skills:

    An academic Degree in IT, engineering, science or mathematics
    Interested in new technologies and a fast learner
    Experience with cloud services
    Experience in a large international environment
    Experience in troubleshooting and root cause analysis
    Be able to work under pressure
    Ability to translate complicated technical matters into simple understandable language
    A broad and versatile profile with one or several areas of deeper technical knowledge

We are looking for a specialist who is willing to develop to a T-Shaped Cloud Specialist and has a background in network.

Additional Information

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information

We welcome your application in English, no later than, 27th of September 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the role, please contact the Hiring Manager Daniël van der Vliet: daniel.van.der.vliet@vattenfall.com for more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our Recruiter Marius Gläßge (marius.glaessge@vattenfall.de).

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall. The screening will be performed by a third party, DISA.



We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Medical oncologist for a modern oncology department in Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Are you a specialist in medical oncology looking for a role that combines professional development, multidisciplinary collaboration, and access to modern cancer treatments?

We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established oncology department in Sweden that provides comprehensive cancer care across a broad spectrum of diagnoses. You will join an experienced and supportive team where collaboration, clinical excellence and continuous development are highly valued.

This is an opportunity to work in a specialty that is constantly evolving, with access to modern therapies and the possibility to contribute to the ongoing development of cancer care while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

About the role

As a specialist in oncology, you will be involved in:

    Outpatient consultations and follow-up of oncology patients.
    Systemic cancer treatments and individualized treatment planning.
    Participation in multidisciplinary tumour conferences (MDTs).
    Inpatient care as part of a rotating ward responsibility.
    Collaboration with radiation oncology, palliative care and other specialties.
    Supervision and mentoring of resident doctors.
    Contributing to the continued development of clinical pathways and oncology services.

Depending on your experience and professional interests, there are opportunities to further develop specific areas of expertise within the department.

Why this opportunity?

    

Collaborative and supportive environment:

Join an experienced oncology team known for its strong collegial atmosphere, close cooperation and willingness to support one another.

    

Modern oncology practice:

Work in a department that continuously follows developments in cancer treatment and offers access to innovative therapies and evidence-based care.

    

Professional development:

Benefit from ongoing opportunities for continuing medical education, subspecialization and participation in developing multidisciplinary tumour teams.

    

Varied clinical work:

Combine outpatient care, inpatient responsibilities, multidisciplinary collaboration and specialised oncology treatments within a broad clinical practice.

    

Long-term career opportunities:

Become part of a stable department with low staff turnover and a strong commitment to quality improvement and professional growth.

Life in central Sweden

The position is located in a scenic region of central Sweden, offering an excellent quality of life with forests, lakes and coastline within easy reach. The area combines a welcoming community atmosphere with modern infrastructure, short commuting times and access to outdoor activities throughout the year.

Families appreciate the safe environment, excellent schools and generous work-life balance, while larger cities and international travel connections remain easily accessible.

Requirements

    EU-recognised specialist certification in Medical Oncology.
    Solid clinical experience as a specialist in oncology.
    Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team.
    Interest in teaching, supervision and professional development.
    Strong communication skills in English.
    Motivation to learn Swedish through our language programme.

Why Choose Dignus Medical?

We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.

What Dignus Medical offers you:

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
    Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family
    Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Interested in a career in Sweden?

Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: IT Security Specialist to Bonava in Stockholm
description:
Lead and develop IT security at Bonava in Stockholm. Work with Azure, Microsoft 365 and cybersecurity in a cloud-first environment

At Bonava, we are not only building houses, we are also creating homes and neighborhoods where people live their lives. To keep our digital world safe, we´re now looking for an IT Security Specialist to lead and develop our cybersecurity landscape.This is a broad role where you will combine strategic vision with hands-on expertise. You will work closely with colleagues across infrastructure, governance and operations to strengthen our security posture, drive continuous improvement and ensure our cloud-first environment remains secure, compliant and resilient.If you are motivated by taking ownership, influencing security strategies and working with modern Microsoft technologies in a business-critical environment, this is an opportunity to make a real impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

At Bonava, you will have the opportunity to shape how we protect our systems, services and data moving forward. You will join an organization where security is an important enabler for the business and where your expertise will influence both strategy and operations.

You will have the opportunity to:

    Take overall responsibility for IT security across Bonava
    Work in a cloud-first environment built primarily on Microsoft Azure
    Influence and develop security frameworks, processes and ways of working
    Combine strategic security initiatives with hands-on technical work
    Collaborate with stakeholders across IT and the wider business
    Enjoy a flexible hybrid working model from our central Stockholm office

Your Challenge

As IT Security Specialist, you will take overall responsibility for IT security at Bonava. This is a broad role where you will work closely with both technical teams and business stakeholders to continuously strengthen the organization’s security posture.

You will:

    Strengthen and maintain security across Bonava’s systems and data
    Monitor the threat landscape and initiate preventive measures
    Manage and develop security infrastructure
    Educate users and promote a strong security culture across the organization
    Drive improvement initiatives related to security and compliance
    Provide informed guidance to management on security risks, incidents and strategic priorities to enhance the organization’s security posture

The Team and Workplace

You will be part of the IT Infrastructure and Compliance team, working alongside colleagues within infrastructure, governance and operations.

Bonava operates with a cloud-first IT strategy, primarily leveraging Microsoft Azure. While the focus is on modern cloud-based solutions, the environment remains hybrid, with certain systems and services still managed on- premises.

The position is based in central Stockholm and offers a hybrid work model with flexibility to work from home.

About You

We believe you will thrive in this role if you have a few years of experience within IT Security or Infrastructure and enjoy working in an environment where strategic thinking and hands-on problem-solving go hand in hand.

You also have:

    Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Security tools, like Defender, Intune and Sentinel
    Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender, Intune and automation
    Understanding of Azure environments and hybrid setups
    Understanding of network security principles
     Experience working with enterprise network environments
    Skills in scripting, preferably PowerShell or Python
    A proactive, structured and responsible approach
    Excellent communication skills in English

As a person, you are collaborative and take initiative to move your work forward. You are a clear and confident communicator who builds trust with stakeholders across the organization. You exercise good judgement, stay up to date with developments in the cybersecurity landscape and enjoy finding practical solutions to complex challenges.

It is considered a plus if you have experience working with governance, risk and compliance frameworks, as well as log management and analysis. Swedish language skills are also considered an advantage.

Let´s Connect!

We have chosen to work with Ada Digital in this hiring process. Their recruitment process focuses on transparency, inclusion and a fast moving candidate experience. And now we want to know more about you – on your own terms! To apply, please fill out the short form, briefly motivate why you are interested in the position, and attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile. No additional documentation is needed. You can then, in real-time, follow your application online as our recruiters are working with it. We work with a continues selection process which means we might hire a candidate before the final apply date, so apply already today! Interested and want to know more? Please contact our recruiter today.  We are looking forward to connecting soon!

title: Project SCM Specialist
description:
The Opportunity

Join HVDC as a Project SCM Specialist!

Bring your expertise to our innovative team at Hitachi Energy and help create a greener future with world-leading technology. HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) develops and sells DC transmission systems globally, used for long-distance electricity transmission and submarine cables.

As part of our Global Supply Chain Management, you'll contribute to major infrastructure projects worldwide, working closely with end customers and enjoying vast career opportunities. If you thrive on complex projects and have a problem-solving and curious mindset, this role is for you!

We value diversity and collaboration, ensuring everyone feels respected and included. Join us and make a difference! #diversity #genderequity #inclusion.

How you’ll make an impact:

    As Project SCM Specialist you will be the focal point between HVDC and our suppliers during the execution phase of our projects.
    You will work closely with Project SCM Managers, Logistic Planners, Engineers, Documentation Control and Suppliers follow up and secure that the equipment and documentation deliveries from our Suppliers is according to agreed time, cost and quality.
    You work in a team with other Project SCM Specialists and will take on equipment’s or project responsibility.
    During the project execution you need to ensure relentless execution with proactive planning and follow-up on all equipment deliveries with our suppliers and internal stakeholders.
    During project execution you will also drive, attend and provide information to kick-off and clarification meetings with suppliers.

    You should also have the ability to stay structured and organized even under pressure and when dealing with many tasks and stakeholders in parallel.
    Enjoy working in project-based environments and collaborating with people from different functions, educational backgrounds, and cultures.
    Excellent written and spoken English skills, as the role involves working in a global organization with international suppliers.

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

This is a hybrid position where you will be based at the Ludvika Hitachi Energy office, with the possibility of working from home up to a couple times per week.

title: Supporttekniker Service Desk
description:
Supporttekniker Service Desk

Vill du arbeta nära nätet som är den digitala ryggraden i samhället?Som Supporttekniker i Service Desk hos GlobalConnect är du med och säkerställer stabil och tillförlitlig kommunikation för GlobalConnects kunder – varje dag 24/7.

Rollen följer ett planerat skiftschema med rotation dygnet runt.

Arbetsuppgifter:

    Incidenthantering vid larm eller avbrott.
    Felsöka nätrelaterade ärenden så som svartfiber, WiFi, SD-WAN, routing, säkerhet med flera layer2 och 3 tjänster.
    Supportera kunder, koordinera med andra avdelningar och underleverantörer via ärendehanteringssystemet.
    Hantera eskalationer och dispatcha ärenden för jämn arbetsfördelning.
    Dokumentera och producera rapporter (RFO/RCA) vid större avbrott.
    Bidra till att förbättra rutiner och processer i Servicedesk.

Om rollen och teamet

I rollen som Supporttekniker får du en central roll i GlobalConnects vardag. Här jobbar du mitt i hjärtat av vår nätverksamhet med att se till att våra största kunder inom B2B alltid får tillgång till stabil och snabb service. Du felsöker, supportar och dokumenterar ofta under tidspress och blir en viktig del i att hålla våra samhällskritiska tjänster tillgängliga.

Tillsammans med kollegor i Servicedesk hanterar du varierande ärenden, oavsett om det handlar om att svara på ett inkommande larm, lösa en teknisk incident eller skicka vidare ett ärende till rätt person. Du kommer oftast ha hjälp från en kollega under skiften, men det kan förekomma tillfällen där du arbetar själv.

Det här jobbet passar dig som gillar struktur, trivs med variation och vill bidra till att våra tjänster håller hög kvalitet, oavsett tid på dygnet. Ingen dag är den andra lik, men varje dag spelar roll för att se till att samhällskritiska funktioner fortsätter att fungera med hjälp av vår digitala infrastruktur.

Den här rollen är för dig som har:

    Relevant utbildning inom nätverk, gärna på högskolenivå.

    1–2 års erfarenhet från Service Desk, Help Desk eller liknande teknisk supportfunktion, gärna mot B2B segmentet.

    Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift för effektiv kommunikation med våra kunder. Danska och norska är också fördelaktigt om du har kunskap i då vi är en Nordisk organisation.

De tekniska krav som ställs i rollen är:

    Router och switchteknik, Huawei, Cisco. (CCNA Routing and Switching: Routing and Switching Essentials)
    Internetteknik (CCNA Routing and Switching: Introduction to Networks)
    Router- och switchteknik i skalbara nät (CCNA Routing and Switching: Scaling Networks)
    WAN-teknik (CCNA Routing and Switching: Connecting Networks)
    Switchteknik (CCNP R&S Switch: Implementing IP Switching)
    Nätverkstekniskfelsökning (CCNP R&S TSHOOT: Maintaining and Troubleshooting IP Networks)
    SD-WAN teknik: Fortinet, Versa
    Trådlösa nätverk: Aruba

Vem vi söker:

Vi söker dig som kommunicerar lugnt och tydligt, även när tempot är högt och flera ärenden behöver hanteras parallellt. Du har ett tydligt kundfokus, tar ansvar för dina ärenden och arbetar strukturerat för att leverera med hög kvalitet. Du har ett genuint intresse för nätverk, teknik och felsökning och trivs med att analysera problem och hitta lösningar. Samtidigt uppskattar du att samarbeta med andra och bidra till ett bra gemensamt resultat.

Varför GlobalConnect?

Du blir en del av ett erfaret team som arbetar med samhällskritisk digital infrastruktur där tillgänglighet, kvalitet och samarbete är avgörande. Från rollen som Supporttekniker finns det karriärvägar internt mot både djupare tekniska roller eller mot produkt- och säljroller. Om du vill ha en fot in till en karriär inom telco är det här en utmärkt möjlighet!

Rekryteringsprocessen

    Talent Acquisition Screeningintervju
    Intervju med rekryterande chef
    Tester - logiskt tänkande samt personlighetstest med uppföljande samtal med Talent Acquisition Partner
    Intervju med chef + teammedlem
    Referenstagning samt bakgrundskoll. Rollen kan komma att bli säkerhetsklassificerad i ett senare skede.

Praktisk information

    Plats: Hagastaden, Stockholm.
    GlobalConnect erbjuder inte hjälp med flytt eller sponsring av arbetstillstånd för den här rollen.
    Rollen följer ett planerat skiftschema med rotation dygnet runt, med en kombination av dag-, kvälls- och nattpass. Helgarbete ingår också som en del av rotationen. Schemat planeras i förväg och innehåller längre sammanhängande ledigheter, inklusive hela lediga veckor vid vissa tillfällen i rotationen. Det ger en kombination av varierande arbetstider och längre perioder av sammanhängande ledighet.

GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

title: Service Desk Specialist
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 5884



Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and directing Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank and its surrounding environment, enabling the Customer Vision and Business Strategy. We are looking for a Service Desk Specialist for a full-time position in the Specialised IT Services Team.

The position is based in Stockholm where you will be working as part of the team supporting Nordea Asset Management, and as such you will be working fully on-site at the Stockholm HQ - Smålandsgatan 17. You will one out of two employees supporting out of Stockholm, but of course belong into the full team of Specialised IT services.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We are not just a bank; we are a technology employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth.

About our team

Meet the Specialised IT Services Team. We are a team of 11 specialist IT professionals delivering high-quality end-user IT support for Nordea Asset Management and Nordea Markets. Our role is to deliver first- and second-level IT support and participate in tasks and projects within our support areas and Group Technology. We operate in a highly sensitive, fast-paced banking environment, where proactive support, ownership, clear communication, and strong service quality is essential.

What you’ll be doing:

    Provide first- and second-level support by troubleshooting and resolving a wide range of IT incidents across hardware and software, ensuring timely and effective support for end users.
    Log, prioritize, track and document incidents in accordance with established incident management procedures, taking ownership to ensure stable and uninterrupted business operations.
    Contribute to smaller IT tasks and larger projects, supporting professional implementation initiatives (Examples being Windows Hello for Business, Entra Joined device rollouts, and testing and deployment of new VPN solutions).

Who you are

This is the right role for you if you:

    Have strong attention to detail and understand the impact IT incidents can have on end users in a banking and trading environment.
    Enjoy working with people and can communicate clearly with traders, business users, internal technology teams and external vendors.
    Take ownership, follow up proactively and remain calm when supporting time-critical incidents.
    Have a structured approach to incident handling, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
    Are curious and willing to build new competences that improve the quality and speed of support.

Your background and skills include:

    Experience from a similar IT support position, preferably within a financial, trading or other business-critical environment.
    Experience with ITIL-based incident management and one or more ITSM systems, preferably including structured ticket logging, prioritization and escalation.
    Proficiency in English and Danish is required.
    Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows, operating systems, workplace applications, hardware, laptops, desktops, printers, and peripherals.
    Know a bit of PowerShell.
    Basic knowledge on Network, VDI’s and Databases.

What we offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These values guide how we work and make decisions – and we imagine you share them with us.

You will join one of the largest Nordic banks, with opportunities to learn, develop, and work with skilled colleagues in a vibrant and diverse working environment. We believe in the value of bringing people together while embracing flexibility where possible. Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work, and we know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 11/09/2026.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us. Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think.

For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

title: Python Backend Engineer
description:
Quartr is a software company serving the world of finance. Every day, leading companies and financial institutions worldwide use our products to research faster and understand deeper.

For too long, markets have been obsessed with numbers. Everyone has access to the same quantitative data, while qualitative insights – the words, the signals, the nuance – have remained mostly in the shadows. We make those insights accessible, searchable, and actionable.

Our products are used daily by some of the most sophisticated teams in finance and tech, including major hedge funds and Magnificent 7 companies, and over a million finance professionals have downloaded our mobile app.

We're backed by some of the smartest minds in our industry and growing fast at a global scale, and we're still at the very beginning of what we expect to be a multi-decade journey.

We are looking for a Python Backend Engineer to play a key role in scaling and improving our transcripts pipelines. If you love engineering robust software, extracting information from text, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you!

Our transcripts team builds and maintains the pipelines that power one of Quartr's most important data assets: transcripts. Your work will provide the core data foundation that powers essential product features and drives future product development.

What you'll do

    Build scalable systems for transcript ingestion, processing, and enrichment from diverse text sources
    Optimise backend performance for high-volume, text-heavy workloads and parallel processing
    Work on text processing and information extraction: entity recognition, metadata enrichment, and semantic structuring of transcripts
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape features from concept to release, ensuring outstanding user experiences
    Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines to ensure smooth operation and timely data delivery

Who you are

    Self-driven, proactive, and confident in taking full ownership of projects
    

    A keen interest in NLP, speech-to-text, or large-scale text pipelines is advantageous
    Comfortable learning new technologies and eager to improve products and processes
    Balance pragmatism and craftsmanship, knowing when to move quickly and when to build for long-term scalability - even in complex systems with many interdependent components
    Communicate clearly and effectively, thriving in a high-paced, collaborative environment
    

    Based in Sweden with a valid work permit

Required skills

    3+ years of professional experience building robust backends in Python, preferably for large-scale or data-intensive systems
    Proven experience developing and maintaining REST APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django
    Familiarity with asynchronous programming and distributed processing
    

    Ability to explain code and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
    Ability to propose durable, simple solutions to complex problems

What we offer

    Do your life's work: The world's leading finance professionals use Quartr daily. We do fewer things better and hold a very high bar for quality.
    

    Join the foundational team: We're still at the very beginning of a multi-decade journey. You'll have a big influence on product, culture, and how we win.
    

    Meritocracy over hierarchy: You'll join a culture where the best idea wins. We value clear thinking, leave ego at the door, and obsess over the details.
    

    Office culture with flexibility: Join us in one of our offices. We value being together, while also offering the flexibility to work from home when needed.
    

    Compensation & well-being: We offer competitive salaries, benefits, and a generous wellness allowance to support your physical and mental health.

We include occupational pension for all employees in Sweden.

title: Researcher in Food Control Literature Review
description:
Department of Animal Biosciences

We are looking for a researcher for a fixed-term position to conduct a scientific literature review on the effects of official food control.

About the position

We are looking for a motivated, thorough and responsible person to join our team. You will work independently on a project, with ongoing support and collaboration from the rest of the team.

A key part of the role will be to conduct a systematic literature review on the effects of official food control. The review will examine how food control influences the behaviour of food businesses and their compliance with food legislation. It will also assess which control methods and approaches have the strongest evidence of improving food safety, compliance, and the accuracy of information provided to consumers, such as food labelling.

Your main tasks will include searching for scientific literature, selecting relevant studies based on the project’s research questions, assessing the quality of the studies, and compiling and analysing the results. You will also identify gaps in current knowledge and areas where further research is needed. The role may also involve conducting interviews with relevant stakeholders, mainly in the Nordic countries.

Your profile

We are looking for someone with a PhD or other documented experience of conducting literature reviews and/or evidence reviews. Previous experience of food control, or other types of regulatory control or inspection, would be an advantage. You will be part of a supportive team while working independently and taking responsibility for this specific task. The applicant must have very good ability to read and write in English. Knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.

About us

The Department of Animal Biosciences is part of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Science and is responsible for education and research in several basic and applied areas. These areas include anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, pharmacology, toxicology, genetics, breeding, immunology, bacteriology, virology, parasitology, epizootology, comparative medicine, food safety, bioinformatics and One Health. Our research covers everything from production animals to sports and pet animals, laboratory animals and wild animals. The department's researchers work on the entire scale from molecular mechanisms and microbiology to the structure, function and behaviour of animals, and how these are affected by breeding, physical activity, care, production, stress, environmental factors and diseases.

For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/Animal-Biosciences/

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

title: Regional Sales Manager - Power Conversion Solutions, Utility-Scale
description:
The opportunity

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Regional Sales Manager to drive sales and business development for our power conversion solutions within the utility-scale renewable energy sector. In this role, you will build and strengthen relationships with key customers, identify new business opportunities, and play a central role in expanding our presence across the region.

Working as part of a small and agile team, you will enjoy a high degree of autonomy and ownership, with a strong focus on delivering ambitious sales targets. The position involves regular travel throughout the region and offers an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-facing environment. While the role does not include direct people management responsibilities, it requires strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions to achieve business growth.

How you’ll make an impact

    Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies for utility-scale power conversion solutions (e.g., inverters, converters for solar, wind, battery storage) to achieve regional revenue and market share goals.
    Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities with utility companies, independent power producers (IPPs), developers, and EPC contractors in the assigned territory.

    Prepare and deliver compelling technical and commercial presentations, proposals, and quotations to clients.
    Negotiate contracts, terms, and conditions to secure profitable sales agreements.
    Collaborate closely with internal teams including engineering, product management, project management, and legal to ensure seamless project execution and customer satisfaction.
    Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats, providing valuable input for product development and strategic planning.
    Participate in industry trade shows, conferences, and events to promote Hitachi Energy's solutions and expand professional networks.
    Provide accurate sales forecasts, reports, and market intelligence to management.
    Ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards.

Your background

    Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field.
    Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive sales experience in the power conversion or renewable energy sector, with a proven track record of selling complex solutions to utility-scale clients.
    In-depth understanding of utility-scale solar, wind, and/or battery energy storage systems and associated power conversion technologies.
    Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and closing skills.
    Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers.
    Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
    Ability to work independently and as part of a global team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
    Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and Microsoft Office Suite.
    Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
    Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; proficiency in other regional languages is a plus.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

title: Senior Research engineer - R&D Downstream Process Development viral vector
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?  

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.  

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

We are looking for a Senior Research Engineer to join the Viral Vector Applications R&D section in Uppsala. The team consists of approximately 20 researchers focused on the development and optimization of downstream processes for viral vectors, plasmids, and nucleic acids, including purification, filtration, and analytical workflows. The work is closely connected to product development, translating process understanding into solutions that meet customer needs.

We are now seeking a new colleague who will work with downstream process development activities for viral vector manufacturing. The role focuses on developing, optimizing, and scaling purification processes, with particular emphasis on filtration and chromatography operations. The successful candidate will apply process understanding to improve productivity, robustness, scalability, and manufacturability while supporting the development of next-generation Cytiva technologies.

What You'll Do:

As a Senior Research Engineer, you will focus on the development, optimization, and implementation of filtration and purification processes for AAV and lentiviral vectors, including harvest and clarification of upstream material. Your work will span new product development, product care, and market support projects, always with a strong customer and process performance focus.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Driving process development activities within filtration and downstream purification, including experimental design, method development, and method verification to ensure robust and scalable processes.
    Applying a holistic understanding of the end-to-end workflow (Upstream to Downstream including analytics) to design efficient, integrated process solutions and provide technically sound recommendations aligned with customer needs and regulatory requirements.
    Independently planning, executing, and analyzing experiments in a structured and data-driven manner, and effectively communicating results in project teams and customer interactions.
    Owning and maintaining process-related infrastructure by ensuring proper use, calibration, and upkeep of instrumentation, as well as developing and updating standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support reproducibility and quality.
    Evaluating, proposing, and implementing new technologies and technical solutions within your area, with a focus on improving process efficiency, robustness, and scalability.
    Contributing to scientific dissemination by preparing and delivering posters and oral presentations at conferences, translating process development outcomes into clear and impactful insights.

Who you are:

    You hold a MSc and have at least 5 years of industrial experience in biopharmaceutical process development, particularly within harvest and downstream processing.
    You have hands-on experience in developing and optimizing end-to-end purification processes, with a strong understanding of critical process parameters, scalability, and process robustness. Experience with viral vectors is highly desirable.
    You enjoy working in the lab, bringing structure to complex tasks, and take pride in maintaining clear, accurate, and well-organized documentation.
    You possess strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex process data into clear insights.
    You are fluent in English (spoken and written) and having working proficiency in Swedish in seen as a plus.

It would be a plus if you also possess experience in:

    Experience working with large-scale production equipment is considered a strong advantage and demonstrates your ability to bridge process development and manufacturing.
    You thrive on working in cross-functional teams, where collaboration and communication are essential to drive projects forward. You enjoy working in a dynamic environment and maintain a strong focus on delivering robust, customer-oriented process solutions.

Application

We continuously assess candidates and invite them for interviews, so please don’t hesitate to write and send in the application. The recruitment will be completed as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

We look forward to seeing your application.

title: Master Thesis Project at Aros electronics
description:
Aros electronics develops and manufactures customized industrial electronics. Motor controls, power electronics, and fieldbus technology are their areas of expertise. In these fields, there is constant advancement of technologies, knowledge levels, and production methods. Aros electronics are not keeping up with technology, they drive it. Want to be a part of their journey? Read more and apply below!

ABOUT THE POSITION:

Friday are on behalf of Aros electronics looking for master thesis students. The master thesis is starting in January 2027 with the aim to result in a permanent position and a tailored talent program of one year together with Friday and Aros, starting in August 2027.

A few examples of thesis areas:

    Advandced control systems
    Power electronics
    Electromagnetics, simulation, modelling and electrical motors
    Machine Learning
    Embedded real-time critical systems

Since Aros develops everything from idea to finished product, they have their own unique production line for PCB:s (printed circuit boards) in-house and also for motor and mechanics via their sister company. This is therefore the perfect master thesis opportunity for you who wants to be close to the product development.

WHY CHOOSE AROS ELECTRONICS FOR YOUR MASTER THESIS?

    World-Class Mentorship:

At Aros electronics, you won't just be a student; you'll be a valued member of our team. You'll have the opportunity to work alongside experts in the field who are passionate about mentoring the next generation of innovators.

    Real-World Impact:

Your Master Thesis Project at Aros electronics won't collect dust on a shelf; it will drive real-world change. They are dedicated to tackling complex challenges and providing solutions that make a difference.

    Access to Cutting-Edge Technology:

Their state-of-the-art facilities are equipped with the latest technology and tools. You'll have access to resources that will enable you to conduct groundbreaking research and push the boundaries of what's possible.

IDEAL CANDIDATE:

The must-haves:

    You are on the last year of your master’s programme in Electrical Power Engineering and Electromobility,  Systems Control and Mechatronics, Sustainable Electric Power Engineering, Embedded Electronics System Design or similiar field.
    You will be available for a master thesis project during the first half of 2027.
    You will be staying in Gothenburg for the foreseeable future and are interested in a full- time position in the talent program with Friday and Aros after completing the thesis project.
    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken because it is communicated within the organization.

The nice-to-haves:

    Excellent communication skills in swedish, both written and spoken.
    Technical side project in electronics, mechatronics, embedded or similiar.
    Have been involved in school activities such as associations and committees.
    Relevant work experience.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Aros electronics develops and manufactures customized electronic solutions for unique customer applications in medium-sized volumes within the industrial and automotive sectors. These solutions encompass everything from electric motors, mechanics, control electronics, to electrical drive systems. Their automotive products are used today in various applications such as servo systems in marine applications, distributed I/O for buses, and subsystems in hybrid vehicles. Their industrial products can be found in applications in machinery like industrial looms, conveyor systems, robot control, and industrial gates. Since 2000, Aros electronics is a part of the Vandewiele Group. Read more about Aros here.

ABOUT THE ASSIGNMENT:

This is a master thesis position with the ambition to be transferred into a full-time employment provided that all parties are satisfied with the project.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

    Start date: January 2027
    Location: Östergårdsgatan 12, Mölndal
    Point of contact: Sophie Tisell, sophie.tisell@friday.se

Apply by clicking "Sök tjänst". Please remember to attach your CV, cover letter and grades.

ABOUT FRIDAY:

By being a partner to our clients and candidates, we strive to find the best match for you both. We achieve this by really getting to know our clients and candidate’s needs! Of course, we will ensure that requirements and skillsets match. But above all, we focus on the importance to find harmony between values and corporate culture which both candidate and client considers optimal.

Our passion is to help people find their dream job within the IT & Tech field. This ambition is a big part of the reason why Friday was founded, aiming to find that work place that workplace that gives you the Friday feeling – every day!

We mainly focusing on young engineers who are at the beginning of their careers or soon graduating from university within the IT and Technology field. Our belief is that people reach their fullest potential when looking forward to going to work each day. ”Friday – everyday”, how about that?

title: Fire Engineer
description:
The opportunity

Do you want to enable green energy transition, and together with colleagues meet the world’s needs for sustainable, flexible and insecure energy?

We are now looking for a Fire Engineer who will be a part of our department at TPC. As a Fire Engineer, you will be involved in coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities, providing technical support for design, testing and commissioning, and ensuring projects are completed within budget and safety standards. We believe that you have knowledge and experience, capable of acting as a design authority, preparing comprehensive project documents, and interacting with customers and contractors. If you enjoy cost-effective, high-quality solutions and thrive in a dynamic environment, we want to hear from you!

Our team culture is flexible and cooperative with the highest regards for safety and occupational health.

This role is based in either Ludvika (Sweden), Mannheim (Germany) or Glasgow (Scotland).

How you'll make an impact

    Ensure fire detection and fire protection system designs comply with applicable standards, regulations, and HVDC-specific requirements.
    Develop and maintain requirement specifications, technical documentation, and design deliverables based on customer requirements, industry standards, and local regulations.
    Coordinate technical interfaces with multiple engineering disciplines throughout all project phases, from design and engineering through testing and commissioning.
    Proactively identify potential technical challenges, risks, and project constraints, and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful project execution.
    Support the onboarding, training, and coaching of new team members and provide technical guidance to customers when required.
    Collaborate closely with colleagues and engineering teams across different functions and geographical locations, promoting knowledge sharing and best practices.
    Participate in regular project meetings, monitor progress, and take timely actions to address technical issues and project needs.
    Develop fire detection and protection system concepts for HVDC tenders, including identifying required clarifications, assumptions, and deviations for both internal and external stakeholders.
    Support tender cost estimation and budgeting activities related to fire detection and protection systems.
    Perform technical risk assessments of proposed tender solutions and implement appropriate mitigation measures to ensure robust and compliant designs
    Develop and maintain Fire Concepts / Fire Strategies for buildings and HVDC facilities, translating fire safety objectives into compliant and practical fire protection solutions.

Your Background

    Degree, diploma, or equivalent experience in Fire Engineering, Fire Safety, Risk Engineering, or a related field.
    Knowledge of fire codes, standards, regulations, and fire safety principles, with the ability to apply them in practical engineering environments.
    Experience with fire modeling, fire simulation tools, or related analytical methods used to assess fire safety and performance requirements.
    Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders and explain technical concepts clearly.

We recognize that candidates may have gained relevant expertise through different combinations of education, professional experience, and industry training, and we encourage applicants with transferable skills to apply.

More about us 

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
    Health care and wellness allowance​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
    Psychological support program​​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

title: Love RevOps, Salesforce, and Gen AI? Join us
description:
At boost.ai, we’re redefining how people interact with companies. As a Gartner Magic Quadrant Conversational AI Challenger, we empower organizations around the world to deliver next-generation customer experiences through intelligent chat and voice automation. Because AI is our core product, we believe in practicing what we preach, using cutting-edge AI tools internally to optimize our way of working. As we continue to scale globally, we’re looking for a process-obsessed, tech-curious Revenue Operations & AI Efficiency Specialist to help keep our revenue engine running smoothly.

Our sales motion doesn’t end at “Closed Won.” You will ensure deals flow seamlessly through Salesforce while actively leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, and modern automation to eliminate manual bottlenecks and supercharge our team's productivity.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Customer Excellence, and Marketing. You’ll be the operational architect ensuring the data, systems, and AI-driven workflows behind every deal work flawlessly.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Execution & Revenue Systems Support:

    Salesforce Record Reviews: Support sales throughout the deal lifecycle by conducting pre-close Salesforce record reviews to ensure accurate billing and reporting readiness.
    Workflow Automation: Assist with active Salesforce administration, supporting flow automation, integrations, testing, and quality checks to ensure reliable data flow.
    Data Hygiene & Accuracy: Ensure exceptional CRM data accuracy and hygiene by validating records, flagging discrepancies, and streamlining data entry.
    System Troubleshooting: Partner with Revenue Management and RevOps leadership to troubleshoot system problems, resolve data issues, and escalate complex technical errors.

AI-Driven Efficiency & Process Optimization

    Identify opportunities to embed AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Slackbot, or internal AI frameworks) into daily RevOps workflows to speed up data handling and reporting.
    Prompt Engineering & Scripting: Create and refine prompts, internal AI assistants, or low-code automations to analyze sales data, draft documentation, and summarize pipeline health.
    Root-Cause Resolution: Eliminate repetitive manual tasks by building automated Salesforce shortcuts or AI-assisted workflows.

Data, Enablement & Cross-Functional Insights

    Dashboard Modernization & Reporting: Build, maintain, and modernize Salesforce reports and dashboards to provide leadership and cross-functional teams with clear visibility into pipeline health, sales performance, and key revenue metrics.
    AI-Enhanced Documentation: Create and maintain clear sales process documentation, playbooks, and system guidance, leveraging AI tools to keep training materials dynamically updated as workflows evolve.
    Sales Onboarding & Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales Enablement and cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Marketing, Customer Success) to support sales training initiatives, ensuring new hires seamlessly adopt our revenue systems and automated workflows.

Skills & Mindset

    1–3 years of experience in Revenue Ops, Sales Ops, Business Operations or a similar role.
    Strong Salesforce Proficiency: Hands-on experience working inside Salesforce is required. You must understand its structure and how fields, objects, and reports interact under the hood.
    AI Tool Fluency: Practical, hands-on experience using Generative AI tools to solve work problems, format data, write formulas, or accelerate daily tasks.
    Comfort with structured data: A natural attention to detail. you instantly spot data irregularities or things that "don't look right."
    Process oriented: The ability to strictly follow defined processes while proactively finding ways to improve them over time.
    Strong communication: Clear communication skills and confidence collaborating across international teams spanning EMEA and North America.

Bonus points if you:

    Have deep experience with Salesforce automation tools (Flows, validation rules, or integrations).
    Understand basic SaaS concepts like subscriptions, ARR, billing cycles, or renewals.
    Enjoy documenting how things work so others don’t have to guess.
    Have partnered with Finance, Marketing, Revenue Management or Customer Success teams before

You’ll love this role if you:

    Get a strange sense of satisfaction from clean data and well-designed processes.
    Dislike doing the same manual task twice and would rather spend time automating or AI-prompting a solution than doing manual data entry.
    Are genuinely excited about the future of AI-driven business productivity.
    Learn fast, ask great questions, and love "connecting the dots" across global teams.Enjoy figuring out how systems work (and why they sometimes don’t)
    Prefer fixing root causes instead of applying manual band-aids
    Like being the person who connects the dots across teams
    Care deeply about things “flowing” correctly from one step to the next
    Are curious about an AI-driven businesses
    Learn fast, ask good questions, and aren’t afraid to dig into details
    Are energized by working in a global, cross-regional environment spanning EMEA and North America
    Get a little nerdy about Salesforce, workflows, and reporting

About boost.ai

Boost.ai is the trusted leader in AI-powered customer experience solutions for regulated industries.

Proven performance and enterprise-grade reliability make boost.ai the partner of choice for leading brands across the US, including Credit Union of Colorado, MSU Federal Credit Union, Coursera, Tokio Marine HCC, and more. Boost.ai is recognized as a Challenger in Gartner’s 2025 Magic QuadrantTM for Conversational AI Platforms.

Our core values—trust, innovation, teamwork, and fun—are central to everything we do. We are committed to building a supportive environment that drives growth, encourages collaboration, and helps us achieve our goals while maintaining a fun and vibrant culture. These values provide a strong foundation that empowers our team members to excel.

It is our policy to provide equal opportunities for employment and career advancement based on an individual's abilities, qualifications, and suitability for the role. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, gender identity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Software Engineer to leading search engine company
description:
We are looking for a software engineer to work on an assignment that will start with 3 months contract. As a Software Engineer, you make direct technical contributions. You execute on assigned software engineering tasks with some guidance, feedback, and support from your manager, tech drive, or other senior team members. The problems you solve have generally had most important assumptions stated and clarified already, and you exercise judgment in determining an appropriate approach from clear options and existing tools.

Responsibilities include:

    Set up or improve test/monitoring/survey infrastructure or processes. Consider code health and system maintainability and scalability over time.
    Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
    Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
    Write product or system development code for sub-tasks with some guidance. Conduct testing on code, design code to allow for easy testing, and write test case descriptions.
    Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
    Pay off tech debt typically identified, scoped, and prioritized by others.

Minimum role qualification requires proficiency in:

    Code and system health
    Data structures and algorithms
    Debugging, diagnosis and resolution
    Programming
    Test engineering
    Code comprehension

title: Senior Tax Specialist / Tax Manager – Gothenburg
description:
We are looking for an experienced Tax Specialist / Tax Manager for an assignment with an international organization in Gothenburg.

The role is part of the Group Tax function and involves responsibility for global tax processes, with a particular focus on Pillar II reporting, as well as tax compliance, planning, and strategy for selected legal entities. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, external advisors, auditors, and tax authorities.

Key Responsibilities

    

Lead and coordinate the Group’s Pillar II reporting

    

Develop and implement global tax strategies to optimize the effective tax rate

    

Provide tax advice related to cross-border transactions, M&A, and restructurings

    

Identify tax optimization opportunities while ensuring alignment with business objectives

    

Manage direct tax filings and payments, ensuring timely compliance

    

Manage tax audits and inquiries from tax authorities

    

Review current and deferred tax calculations

    

Review tax provisions under local GAAP for selected legal entities

    

Monitor developments in local and international tax legislation and support implementation of relevant changes

    

Maintain robust internal controls to mitigate direct tax risks

    

Collaborate with external tax advisors and auditors to ensure accurate tax reporting

Your Background

We are looking for a tax professional with a strong combination of technical expertise, analytical ability, and business understanding. You should have:

    

A university degree in Law, Finance, or a related field

    

Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience within tax

    

Good understanding of finance processes and systems

    

Strong knowledge of international taxation, US tax legislation, and tax accounting standards

    

Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills

    

Strong business acumen and a high level of integrity

You are self-motivated, proactive, and solution-oriented, with the ability to identify improvements and take ownership of complex issues. You are also comfortable working in a fast-paced international environment and communicating effectively with multiple stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced tax professional who wants to take on a key role in global tax reporting, compliance, and strategic tax matters within a complex international organization.

Start of assignment: 2026-08-24 End of assignment: 2026-12-31  Scope: Part-time to full-time (TBC) Application deadline: 31 August 2026

Location: Gothenburg
