title: MTR/MTRA (w/m/d) - MRT + Angiographie - Spital in der Nordschweiz - 3 Fachkräfte gesucht (Medizinische/r Technologe/Technologin - Radiologie)
employer: Personal Spezial Personalservice & Vermittlung Hansjürgen Mathiak
description:
Bereit für das nächste große Kapitel? Erfülle Deine Berufung in der Schweiz!
Du liebst Deinen Beruf als MTR / MTRA, aber spürst, dass es Zeit für eine echte Veränderung ist? Für mehr Wertschätzung, modernste Technik und Lebensqualität, die diesen Namen auch verdient?
Wir verstehen Dich. Seit 25 Jahren begleiten wir als erfolgreiche Vermittlungsagentur Menschen wie Dich dabei, den Arbeitsplatz zu finden, der nicht nur zum Lebenslauf, sondern perfekt zum Leben passt. Für eine renommierte Klinikgruppe in der malerischen Nordschweiz suchen wir genau jetzt Deine Expertise.
Schließe kurz die Augen und stell Dir vor, wie es sich anfühlt, in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, in dem Deine Leistung täglich gesehen und honoriert wird. Wir haben aktuell 3 exklusive Vakanzen zu besetzen – eine davon wartet vermutlich genau auf Dich.
Deine zukünftigen Highlights: MRT & Angiologie auf Top-Niveau
Du bist der Experte, der Bilder sprechend macht. In Deiner neuen Rolle verbindest Du technologische Präzision mit menschlicher Empathie:
High-End-Diagnostik im MRT: Du steuerst modernste MRT-Systeme und meisterst komplexe Fragestellungen mit Leichtigkeit.
Dynamik in der Angiologie: Bei interventionellen Eingriffen und Gefäßdarstellungen bist Du die unverzichtbare rechte Hand des Teams – ruhig, fokussiert und kompetent.
Patienten-Empathie: Du schenkst Menschen in Ausnahmesituationen Sicherheit und das Gefühl, in den besten Händen zu sein.
Warum dieser Schritt Dein Leben verändern wird
Vielleicht hast Du schon länger über die Schweiz nachgedacht. Lass uns gemeinsam hinschauen, was Dich hier wirklich erwartet:
Spürbare Wertschätzung & Spitzen-Gehalt: Schweizer Saläre und hervorragende Sozialleistungen bieten Dir eine finanzielle Freiheit und Sicherheit, die Du so wahrscheinlich noch nicht kennst.
Zeit für das Wesentliche: Ein exzellenter Personalschlüssel sorgt dafür, dass Du Dich wieder voll und ganz auf Deine Patienten und die Bildqualität konzentrieren kannst – ohne permanenten Stress.
Lebensqualität pur: Die Nordschweiz bietet Dir die perfekte Balance. Atemberaubende Natur, die Alpen vor der Haustür und gleichzeitig die unmittelbare Nähe zur deutschen Heimat.
Dein Rundum-Sorglos-Paket: Wir sind an Deiner Seite. Von der SRK-Anerkennung Deines Diploms über die Wohnungssuche bis hin zu allen bürokratischen Schritten – wir halten Dir den Rücken frei.
Das bringst Du mit auf diese Reise:
Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTR / MTRA.
Fundierte, professionelle Erfahrung in den Bereichen MRT und Angiologie/DSA.
Die Bereitschaft, Dich auf ein neues, wertschätzendes System einzulassen und Dich weiterzuentwickeln.
Du musst diesen Weg nicht alleine gehen. Vertraue auf 25 Jahre Erfahrung und ein Netzwerk, das Türen öffnet. Lass uns in einem ganz unverbindlichen, vertraulichen Telefongespräch herausfinden, ob diese Chance Dein Herz höherschlagen lässt.
Mach jetzt den ersten Schritt in Deine neue Freiheit.

vor Ort Roggwil TG, Thurgau, Schweiz

Die kybun Joya Retail AG in Roggwil gehört zur kybun Joya Gruppe, welche Komfortschuhe und weitere Gesundheitslösungen in der Schweiz entwickelt, produziert und in mehr als 40 Ländern vertreibt. Ziel ist es, den Menschen durch kompetente Beratung schmerzfreie Bewegung zu ermöglichen.

Sie sorgen für eine stabile, sichere Netzwerk- und Systemlandschaft und treiben aktiv die Integration von KI-Lösungen in unsere Geschäftsprozesse voran. Die Rolle ist eng verzahnt mit dem E-Commerce-, Support- und Marketing-Team.

Ihre Aufgaben

Netzwerk & IT-Infrastruktur

- Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Netzwerkinfrastruktur an unseren Standorten Roggwil, Sennwald und unseren eigenen Shops in Europa (LAN/WLAN, Firewalls, VPN, Switching, Routing)
- Betrieb und Pflege der Server-, Client- und Cloud-Umgebung (Microsoft 365, Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams Telefonie)
- Verwaltung von Endgeräten inkl. Device Enrollment, Intune-Policies und Lizenzmanagement
- Konfiguration und Pflege von Domains, DNS-, SPF- und Zertifikatsstrukturen (z. B. sichere LDAP-Zertifikate, Mail-Deliverability)
- Hardware-Beschaffung & -Verwaltung (Client/Server)
- Gelegentlicher Vor-Ort-Support für Shops, inkl. Reisetätigkeit bei Neueinrichtungen

IT-Sicherheit & Compliance

- Sicherstellung der IT-Sicherheit durch Patch-Management, Zero-Trust-Ansätze, MFA und Endpoint Protection
- Incident Response bei Sicherheitsvorfällen (z. B. Phishing, kompromittierte Accounts) inkl. interner Kommunikation
- Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender in Sicherheitstools wie Bitwarden (Passwortmanagement)
- Unterstützung bei ISO 9001 Audits und Umsetzung von Compliance-Vorgaben

Monitoring, Support & Systempflege

- Monitoring, Troubleshooting und 2nd-Level-Support für Netzwerk, Systeme und User Requests
- Bearbeitung und Priorisierung von IT-Tickets und Weiterentwicklung des Ticket-Prozesses
- Planung und Durchführung von Systemupdates, Rollouts und Migrationen mit minimaler Downtime
- Dokumentation von Prozessen, Konfigurationen und Wissensdatenbank-Artikeln

KI-Integration & Automatisierung

- Integration von KI in bestehende Prozesse und Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, Kundenservice und Marketing
- Design, Erstellung und Optimierung von Prompts für generative KI-Modelle (z. B. für Übersetzungen, Kundenservice, Content-Erstellung)

description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Wetzikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutspital.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wetzikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die dynamische Stadt bietet Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie, Handel und Dienstleistungen. Die attraktive Lage zwischen Zürich und dem Appenzellland, kombiniert mit guter Infrastruktur und hoher Lebensqualität, macht Wetzikon zu einem wertvollen Arbeitsort für Pendler und Ortsansässige.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German

title: System Administrator Microsoft Workplace
description:
System Administrator Microsoft Workplace (80\-100%)  
WIR SUCHEN  
per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine:n  
System Administrator Microsoft Workplace (80\-100%)  
Du hast deine Ausbildung als Informatiker:in EFZ (Fachrichtung Plattformentwicklung) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen und bereits erste Berufserfahrung im Betrieb von Windows\- und Microsoft\-Umgebungen gesammelt. Du weisst, dass ein stabiler Betrieb mehr ist als das Bearbeiten von Tickets. Es geht darum, Systeme und ihre Abhängigkeiten ganzheitlich zu verstehen, Auffälligkeiten durch proaktives Monitoring frühzeitig zu erkennen und Störungen mit einer strukturierten Ursachenanalyse nachhaltig zu beheben. Eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit steht dabei jederzeit im Zentrum. In unserem Team Smart Workplace übernimmst du Verantwortung für den stabilen Betrieb unserer Clients, Server, Microsoft\-365\-Umgebungen sowie unserer Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops Plattform. Als zentrale technische Anlaufstelle priorisierst du Incidents nach Service Level und Business Impact und begleitest sie von der ersten Triage bis zur nachhaltigen Lösung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen System Engineers zusammen, die ihr Wissen aktiv weitergeben. Support, Betrieb und Engineering greifen bei uns eng ineinander. So kannst du technische Verantwortung übernehmen, deine Stärken gezielt einbringen und dich in einer zentralen Betriebsrolle fachlich weiterentwickeln. Wenn du Systeme nicht nur betreiben, sondern wirklich verstehen möchtest, passt du gut zu uns.  
Was dich erwartet  
Betrieb und Pflege von Clients und Servern im Microsoft 365 und Windows Umfeld  
Konfiguration, Wartung und Lifecycle von Clients, Servern und Citrix Komponenten  
Analyse und Lösung technischer Störungen, remote und vor Ort  
Bearbeitung von Service Requests und Changes nach klaren, strukturierten Abläufen  
Verantwortung für das Inventar von Hardware und Software sowie für saubere Dokumentation  
Mitarbeit in Projekten rund um Workplace, Cloud und Infrastruktur  
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit System Engineers, Network und Security

Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

Un environnement de travail engagé

We are a Private Recovery Clinic, experts in addiction and affective disorders, providing exceptional treatment and care to an international clientele. Situated on the spectacular shores of Lake Lucerne, we are an English\-speaking boutique clinic treating those suffering from addiction and affective disorders such as depression and anxiety. Our team is dedicated to helping people achieve long\-term recovery through compassionate care.  
The role  
We are currently recruiting dedicated and experienced Recovery Counsellors (100%) to join our multidisciplinary team. The ideal candidate combines personal recovery experience, professional competence, and a strong commitment to supporting others on their recovery journey. In this role, you will work closely with medical and mental health professionals to provide comprehensive care, guidance, and encouragement to our clients.

A minimum of 10 years of continuous abstinence from all psychoactive substances  
Excellent written and spoken English (C2 professional proficiency); other languages are an advantage

A relevant form of training or work experience  
The ability to work with a culturally diverse clientele  
A current driver’s license and willingness to drive

title: Commercial Excellence Lead (m/f/d)
description:
Within the Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA). Commercial Operations & Strategy Organization, the Commercial Excellence Lead will elevate commercial excellence across the region, enable strong alignment across multiple functions and divisions, and lead commercial-capability readiness for our emerging launch pipeline in EEMEA. Strong, trusted partnership with cluster commercial operations teams is essential to the success of this role. Key stakeholders will be the EEMEA Leadership Team (LT), HHI Commercial Operations, regional Chief Marketing Officers (CMO) & Regional Commercial Leads (RCL), and market Commercial Operations Directors (CODs.)
This is a Band 400 individual-contributor role. The primary location is Switzerland, with secondary locations in the Europe or Middle East time zones may be considered upon further discussion with the hiring manager. The role includes approximately 25% travel within Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities:
Commercial Capabilities:  Drive customer engagement evolution in partnership with Digital Engagement teams, ensuring commercial capabilities, segmentation, omnichannel execution and customer insights are translated into improved customer experience and business outcomes.
Relevant focus areas include:
•    Sales Force Effectiveness: Ensure proper Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), target setting, CRM operations and upgrades, and Sales Force of the Future (SFOF) deployment in select markets.  Ensure an ongoing focus on segmentation and targeting and Multichannel Cycle Plans (MCCP) efforts in the region.  Leverage data, analytics and business insights to improve sales force effectiveness in the region.
•    Key Account Management:  Ensure the roll out of Key Account Management and Top Customer programs in the region. Ensure successful capability roll-out and work with Market Access and Franchises to increase access at account level.
•    Commercial Trade Channels: Align with HHI on new capability roll-out and support markets in uncovering Commercial Trade Channel (CTC) opportunities.
Operational Governance & Execution:  Work with all relevant stakeholders to secure the EEMEA Commercial Operations & Strategy (CO&S) vision and business strategies and proactively identify and execute projects and programs of strategic importance to the region and our customers in a timely, effective, and efficient fashion. Be the communicator / connector / catalyst for cross-functional projects managed by extended regional stakeholders. Relevant focus areas include:
•    CO&S Governance: Manage all governance activities for the CO&S department, including setting the agenda for virtual and face-to-face meetings and periodic forum calls with market leads and other relevant stakeholders.
•    Business Impact Measurement: Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of commercial capability investments, ensuring visibility to adoption, effectiveness, customer outcomes and business value realization.
•    Continuous Improvement: Continue to identify opportunities to drive simplification and harmonization across the region in collaboration with CO&S stakeholders including Digital Human Health (DHH). Support markets and the region in Objective & Key Result (OKR) transformation projects where requested.  Bring external industry best practices and innovative approaches into the region to continuously elevate commercial excellence.
•    Marketing Capabilities: Partner with regional Learning & Development (L&D), CMOs, and RCLs to build and scale marketing capabilities with a focus on L3 next deployment and sustainment.
•    Regional Projects: Ensure the successful deployment of projects associated with regional initiatives, priorities, and experimentations.
Launch Excellence:  Lead commercial-capability readiness that carries our emerging pipeline to flawless launch execution across markets. Relevant focus areas include:
•    Launch Capability Readiness: Partner with RCLs and market teams to ensure markets have the appropriate Go to Market (G2M) planning, segmentation, targeting, field-force sizing, training, forecasting support, and launch playbooks are in place well ahead of launch.
•    Launch Framework & Tracking: Establish a repeatable EEMEA launch-excellence framework and toolkit, with launch tracking that gives leadership visibility to timelines, milestones and risks.
AI-Enabled Commercial Excellence:  Champion the responsible adoption of GenAI across commercial workflows — helping teams work faster and smarter while safeguarding compliance and quality — and explore opportunities to embed AI into sales, marketing, field-force and launch ways of working, in partnership with key stakeholders.
Talent Development:  Build & support commercial-operations talent and capability development across the region.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader with 10+ years across sales, marketing, commercial operations and launch readiness who has successfully deployed commercial excellence capabilities in a complex, multinational environment. Combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, excels at influencing without authority, and has a strong track record of leading change, building capabilities, and translating data and technology into measurable business outcomes.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!

Conducteur de Travaux \- Rénovation \& Transformation

Notre client est un acteur établi du secteur de la construction en Suisse romande. Grâce à son expertise technique, à ses équipes expérimentées et à sa capacité à mener des projets complexes, l'entreprise intervient sur des chantiers variés de rénovation, de transformation et de réhabilitation de bâtiments. Elle propose un environnement dynamique, axé sur la qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle, au sein duquel chaque collaborateur bénéficie d'un réel niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilités.

Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et du suivi complet de vos chantiers de rénovation et de transformation, de la phase de préparation jusqu'à leur réalisation finale.

Planifier les différentes étapes des travaux, notamment les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en équipements.  
Organiser le déroulement quotidien des chantiers et assurer leur exécution opérationnelle.  
Coordonner les équipes, les sous\-traitants et les différents corps de métier.  
Assurer la commande, l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des matériaux nécessaires.  
Anticiper les éventuelles contraintes liées à l'occupation, à l'exploitation ou à la structure des bâtiments existants.  
Mettre en place et suivre les procédures liées à la qualité, à la sécurité et à l'environnement.  
Contrôler l'avancement des travaux ainsi que le respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences techniques.  
Assurer le suivi financier des chantiers.  
Élaborer les offres, les offres complémentaires et les métrés des travaux réalisés.  
Participer à la facturation et au contrôle des prestations exécutées.  
Participer aux séances de chantier et assurer le suivi des décisions prises.  
Entretenir une relation professionnelle de qualité avec les maîtres d'ouvrage, les directions de travaux, les mandataires et les partenaires du projet.

Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation reconnue de conducteur(trice) de travaux.  
Vous justifiez d'au moins cinq ans d'expérience confirmée dans la conduite de chantiers en Suisse.  
Vous disposez d'une expérience concrète dans le domaine de la rénovation et de la transformation.  
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels ainsi que le logiciel BauBit.  
Vous êtes à l'aise dans le suivi technique, administratif et financier des chantiers.  
Vous êtes une personne proactive, autonome, organisée et dotée d'un bon sens des responsabilités.  
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer efficacement avec les différents intervenants d'un chantier.  
Vous êtes capable de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement exigeant et en constante évolution.

title: Conducteur de Travaux - Terrassement
description:
Conducteur de Travaux \- Terrassement  
Conducteur de Travaux \- Terrassement  
Description de l'entreprise  
Notre client est un acteur établi du secteur de la construction en Suisse romande. Grâce à son expertise technique, à ses équipes expérimentées et à sa capacité à réaliser des projets d'envergure, l'entreprise intervient sur des chantiers variés dans le domaine du terrassement et des infrastructures. Elle propose un environnement dynamique, axé sur la qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle, au sein duquel chaque collaborateur bénéficie d'un réel niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilités.  
Description du poste  
Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et du suivi complet de vos chantiers de terrassement, de la phase de préparation jusqu'à leur réalisation finale.  
Préparer les chantiers sur les plans technique, organisationnel et financier.  
Planifier les différentes étapes des travaux, notamment les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en équipements.  
Organiser le déroulement quotidien des chantiers et assurer leur exécution opérationnelle.  
Coordonner les équipes, les sous\-traitants et les différents intervenants.  
Assurer la commande, l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des matériaux et équipements nécessaires.  
Mettre en place et suivre les procédures liées à la qualité, à la sécurité et à l'environnement.  
Contrôler l'avancement des travaux ainsi que le respect des délais et des coûts.  
Assurer le suivi financier des chantiers.  
Élaborer les offres, les offres complémentaires et les métrés des travaux réalisés.  
Participer à la facturation et au contrôle des prestations exécutées.  
Participer aux séances de chantier et assurer le suivi des décisions prises.  
Entretenir une relation professionnelle de qualité avec les maîtres d'ouvrage, les directions de travaux et les partenaires du projet.  
Profil recherché  
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation reconnue de conducteur(trice) de travaux.  
Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience confirmée dans la conduite de chantiers en Suisse.  
Vous disposez d'une expérience concrète dans le domaine du terrassement.  
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels ainsi que le logiciel BauBit.  
Vous êtes à l'aise dans le suivi technique, administratif et financier des chantiers.  
Vous êtes une personne proactive, autonome, organisée et dotée d'un bon sens des responsabilités.  
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer efficacement avec les différents intervenants d'un chantier.

Egal ob du eine fachliche Frage oder ein persönliches Anliegen hast, bei uns wirst du immer jemanden antreffen, der mit dir gemeinsam eine Lösung findet. Fairness

Das Arbeits- und Geschäftsleben ist ein Geben und Nehmen. Um langfristig erfolgreich zu sein, achten wir bei KUMAVISION sehr auf Fairness und Transparenz. Dies gilt intern für unsere Zusammenarbeit im Team, aber auch nach außen für unser Verhalten gegenüber unseren Geschäftspartnern und Kunden. Bei KUMAVISION schaffen wir faire Bedingungen für dich und begegnen dir mit einem großen Vertrauensvorschuss.

Performance

Die Lust auf Leistung und Erfolg ist bei KUMAVISION spürbar. Unser Drive kommt aus der Technologie, mit der wir arbeiten, von den Kunden, die uns fordern, aber vor allem aus uns selbst. Bei unseren Projekten treten wir an, innovative Lösungen zu finden und Prozesse zu optimieren. KUMAVISION ist langfristig erfolgreich, weil es uns gelingt, den Erfahrungsschatz und die Zusammenarbeit in unserem Team optimal zu nutzen. Natürlich werden wir deine Leistung hierfür entsprechend würdigen.

Flexibilität

Wer auf ständige Entwicklung und Verbesserung setzt, muss selbst offen und flexibel sein. Wir passen uns an neue Herausforderungen, an die Besonderheiten verschiedener Branchen und an neue Technologien an. Dafür bieten wir dir, so wie allen Mitarbeitenden viel Freiraum für flexibles Arbeiten und laufende Weiterentwicklung.

Vision

KUMAVISION stärkt die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit mittelständischer Unternehmen aus verschiedensten Branchen durch ebenso zuverlässige wie visionäre Lösungen. Als Team von Expertinnen und Experten machen wir unsere Kunden mit modernster Technologie, umfangreichem Branchenwissen und durch unsere langjährige Partnerschaft mit Microsoft systematisch und nachhaltig leistungsfähiger.

title: (Senior) Netzingenieur*in (gn) im Produktmanagement digitaler Netzzwilling (Produktmanager/in)
description:
Wir suchen nicht zwingend eine fertige Produktmanagerin und keinen fertigen Produktmanager. Wir suchen Netz-Know-how.

Darum geht es:

Wir bauen mit der gaia powergrids Modulsuite einen digitalen Zwilling des Stromnetzes: eine Plattform, die Verteilnetzbetreiber unter anderem bei der Anschlussprüfung und der Zielnetzplanung unterstützt – dort also, wo heute Excel, Erfahrungswerte und lange Wartezeiten für Anschlusskunden aufeinandertreffen.

Für die Weiterentwicklung dieser Modulsuite suchen wir eine Person, die Netzpraxis mitbringt und mit dem Produktmanagement die fachlichen Konzepte erstellt, validiert und das Anforderungsmanagement dafür übernimmt. Du weißt, wie ein Netz wirklich geplant, gerechnet und bewertet wird – und übersetzt dieses Wissen in ein Produkt, das Netzbetreiber täglich nutzen.

‍

Das sind deine Aufgaben:

- Federführung für die fachlichen Konzepte der neuen powergrids Module – von der ersten Idee über die Validierung mit Kund*innen bis zur abgestimmten Spezifikation.
- Fachliche Instanz für elektrotechnische und planerische Fragestellungen rund um das Produkt – du stellst sicher, dass unsere Verfahren dem Stand der Technik entsprechen und in der Praxis der Netzbetreiber tragen.
- Anforderungsmanagement: Anforderungen aus Kundenprojekten, Markt, Regulatorik und Datenanalysen strukturiert sammeln, schärfen und priorisieren.
- Übersetzen fachlicher Anforderungen in Konzepte, User Journeys und technische Spezifikationen – gemeinsam mit Engineering, Data Science und Design.
- Fachliche Bewertung von Netzmodellen, Netztopologien, Berechnungsverfahren, Datenflüssen und Schnittstellen – und Ableiten klarer Produktentscheidungen.
- Einbringen deiner Netzperspektive in Produktstrategie und Roadmap, gemeinsam mit Product Owner und Produktleitung.
- Enger Austausch mit Pilotkund*innen, Partner*innen sowie unseren Kolleg*innen aus Sales und Customer Success.

‍

Das bringst du mit:

- Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium – Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen mit energietechnischer Vertiefung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Praxiserfahrung bei oder für einen Verteilnetzbetreiber bzw. Energieversorger in einer technischen Rolle mit Stromnetzbezug – also auch, wenn du diese Erfahrung als Dienstleister*in, im Ingenieurbüro oder in der Beratung gesammelt hast.

Zum Beispiel als:

- Netzplaner*in oder Grundsatzplaner*in (Mittel- und/oder Niederspannung)
- Netzberechner*in
- Ingenieur*in im Netzanschluss- oder Kundenanschlussprozess
- Asset Manager*in
- Mitarbeiter*in in Netzbetrieb, Betriebsführung oder Netzführung
- Projektierer*in oder Ingenieur*in in Netzdokumentation / GIS
- Fundiertes technisches Netzverständnis: Du kennst das Stromnetz und seine Betriebsmittel im Detail. Lastfluss- und Kurzschlussberechnungen kannst du einordnen und interpretieren – oder du bringst die Grundlagen mit, um dich schnell darin einzuarbeiten.
- Idealerweise hast du selbst schon Anschlussprüfungen für neue Anlagen in mindestens einer Spannungsebene durchgeführt und/oder eine Zielnetzplanung erstellt.
- Ein Gespür dafür, welche technischen Fragen ein Netzbetreiber beantworten muss, bevor er einen Anschluss zusagt oder einen Netzausbau beschließt.
- Analytisches, datengetriebenes Denken und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
- Freude daran, Komplexität verständlich zu machen und Entscheidungen voranzutreiben.
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; gutes Englisch.

‍

Schön, wenn du es mitbringst – kein Muss

- Vertrautheit mit den einschlägigen Regelwerken zur Bewertung neuer Anschlussbegehren – in Deutschland z. B. VDE-AR-N 4100/4105/4110/4120 und die TAB, in der Schweiz die entsprechenden Werke von VSE und Netzbetreibern.
- Erfahrung mit Netzberechnungssoftware (z. B. PowerFactory, Integral, NEPLAN, pandapower, Sincal).
- Kenntnisse regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen in Deutschland und/oder der Schweiz (z. B. Netzanschluss, Ausbauplanung, EEG/Redispatch, Anschlussbegehren-Prozesse).
- Verständnis von Schnittstellen und Systemlandschaften beim Netzbetreiber (GIS, ERP, Leitsystem).
- Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, mit agilen Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) oder in Softwareprojekten.
- Interesse/Know-how, wie KI, Simulationen und Datenmodelle in Softwareprodukte einfließen.
- Offene, positive Persönlichkeit, die den Austausch liebt und Freude an einem modernen, kooperativen Arbeitsumfeld hat.
- Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – du kannst technische Zusammenhänge so erklären, dass Engineering, Design und Vertrieb sie gleichermaßen verstehen.
- Hohe Motivation, sinnvolle Entscheidungen voranzutreiben.
- Spaß an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit – von Engineering bis Sales.

‍

Auch wenn du noch nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst:

Vielleicht hast du noch nie eine Roadmap gepflegt, kein Backlog priorisiert und noch nie das Wort „User Journey" benutzt. Das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du in einer technischen Rolle beim Netzbetreiber gearbeitet hast, das Netz und seine Prozesse wirklich kennst und Lust hast, dein Wissen in ein digitales Produkt einzubringen statt in die nächste Anschlussprüfung im Einzelfall – dann bewirb dich. Wir bringen dir das Produkthandwerk bei; dein Netz-Know-how können wir nicht ersetzen.

title: Night Audit (m/w/d) (Night-Auditor)
description:
Night Audit (m/w/d)

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Unser Herz schlägt türkis.

Arbeiten bei Motel One ist wie zu Freunden kommen, wo Wertschätzung und Unterstützung grossgeschrieben werden und die individuelle Persönlichkeit willkommen ist. Wir begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe und verstehen uns als ein Team: von der Geschäftsführung bis zu den Auszubildenden.

Mit unserer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für modernes Design und hohe Servicequalität schaffen wir für unsere Gäste bei Motel One ein Zuhause für unterwegs. Unsere mehr als 95 Hotels in 13 Ländern überzeugen mit exklusivem Design, hohen Servicestandards und erstklassigen innerstädtischen Standorten zu einem attraktiven Preis.

Als Begründer und Vorreiter des Budget Design Konzepts expandieren wir erfolgreich in den Metropolen Europas und darüber hinaus. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Motel One.

Stellenbeschreibung

Die professionelle Betreuung unserer Gäste am Empfang ist zu jeder Zeit sehr wichtig – von der herzlichen Begrüßung beim Check-In bis zur Verabschiedung, bist Du für die Frühaufsteher und Nachtschwärmer unter unseren Gästen da. Dabei kümmerst Du dich ausserdem um:

- Erstellung der Tagesabschlüsse
- Kassenführung und -abrechnung
- Bearbeitung von Reservierungsanfragen
- Frühstücksvorbereitung

Benefits:

- Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus.
- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.
- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.
- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

Ob als Hotelprofi oder im Quereinstieg – Du passt zu uns! Denn Persönlichkeit und Gastgeberqualitäten stehen bei uns an erster Stelle! Ausserdem zeichnet dich aus:

- Ausbildung im Hotelfach bzw. Berufserfahrung in der Hotellerie/Gastronomie oder Interesse an einem Quereinstieg
- Gastgeberqualitäten und Leidenschaft für die Hotellerie sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Serviceorientierung
- Offenes, kommunikatives und sicheres Auftreten sowie eine gute Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch & Englisch
- Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft abteilungsübergreifend zu unterstützen – Wir erreichen unsere Erfolge gemeinsam

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship

- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future

title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6

Job flexibility: Hybrid

title: Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

title: Recovery Counsellors 100%
description:
Recovery Counsellors 100%  
About us  
We are a Private Recovery Clinic, experts in addiction and affective disorders, providing exceptional treatment and care to an international clientele. Situated on the spectacular shores of Lake Lucerne, we are an English\-speaking boutique clinic treating those suffering from addiction and affective disorders such as depression and anxiety. Our team is dedicated to helping people achieve long\-term recovery through compassionate care.  
The role  
We are currently recruiting dedicated and experienced Recovery Counsellors (100%) to join our multidisciplinary team. The ideal candidate combines personal recovery experience, professional competence, and a strong commitment to supporting others on their recovery journey. In this role, you will work closely with medical and mental health professionals to provide comprehensive care, guidance, and encouragement to our clients.  
Start date: immediately or by agreement.  
Skills and qualifications  
A minimum of 10 years of continuous abstinence from all psychoactive substances  
Excellent written and spoken English (C2 professional proficiency); other languages are an advantage  
Active and ongoing participation in personal recovery work or mutual aid groups, such as Narcotics Anonymous, Alcoholics Anonymous, Gamblers Anonymous, etc.  
A clear understanding of your recovery process and the ability to express it in a differentiated manner

A relevant form of training or work experience  
The ability to work with a culturally diverse clientele  
A current driver’s license and willingness to drive  
Ability to commute or relocate close to Lucerne, Switzerland  
Ability to work in shifts (combination of day, overnight, weekends, holidays)  
Must be eligible for a work permit in Switzerland (CH/EU\-/EFTA nationals). An EU passport is ideal for obtaining a work permit if you are applying outside Switzerland.

Working as a valued member of the clinical team, our Recovery Counsellors offer essential motivation, support, and guidance to our clients as they embark on their recovery journey with the utmost care and consideration for confidentiality. You will have the opportunity to use your own recovery experience to inspire and guide clients through their recovery process, moderate and deliver group sessions, escort the clients to mutual aid groups in Zurich and Lucerne, accompany them to various off\-site activities, organising and supervising overnight, on\-call, and weekend plans. title: Sport Facilities Manager & Activity Coordinator
description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Sport Facilities Manager & Activity Coordinator
to join the school from: 01.11.2026

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 28.09.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE
Lead, safeguard and develop Aiglon’s sports and activities provision so that every pupil, staff member and guest enjoys an inclusive, high-quality and safe programme.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Safety & Compliance
Conduct daily facility walk-throughs, logging hazards and initiating corrective action, which includes taking action to fix equipment where possible
Enforce best practice in child safeguarding and health & safety, fully aligned with Swiss regulations and Aiglon policies
Maintain inspection and servicing schedules for all sports equipment; liaise with the Director of Operations for repairs or replacement
Help to manage the bookings of the minibus fleet for the expeditions and sports departments
Ensure that the minibuses are in good order after use
Secure the Sports Centre at the end of the day or open hours (equipment check, lights, alarms, locks)
Programming & User Experience
Produce and publish the weekly Sports Centre and facilities timetable, balancing curriculum lessons, house practices, team training and community bookings. This includes the Padel Court, Alpina Pitch, Ski Lockers along with other sports spaces and facilities
Encourage a broad, lifelong engagement in physical activity by promoting a wide range of sports and wellbeing initiatives
Liaise proactively with the Health Centre, Deputy School Director (Pastoral) and Houseparents regarding students with medical or additional-needs profiles
Communicate clearly and courteously with all users, modelling professional conduct that earns trust from pupils and colleagues
Fitness Suite & Strength-and-Conditioning
